    render(<ProductStatusBanner isCollaborator={false} hasRecipe={false} targetMargin={30} margin={0} />)

    for (const texto of [screen.getByText('Estado del producto'), screen.getByText(/Agregá materias primas/)]) {
      // gray-500 sobre gray-100 da 4,39:1 y sobre gray-900, 3,66:1.
      expect(texto).not.toHaveClass('text-gray-500')
      expect(texto).toHaveClass('text-gray-600', 'dark:text-gray-400')
    }
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/[id]/components/PresentationDeleteDialog.tsx">
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle, LoaderCircle, Star, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

import { useTokenGetter } from '@/hooks/useTokenGetter'
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogBackdrop,
  DialogClose,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogPopup,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type SupplierPresentation } from '@/services/supplierService'

interface PresentationDeleteDialogProps {
  open: boolean
  supplierId: string
  presentation: SupplierPresentation | null
  onClose: () => void
  onDeleted: (presentation: SupplierPresentation) => void
}

export function PresentationDeleteDialog({
  open,
  supplierId,
  presentation,
  onClose,
  onDeleted,
}: PresentationDeleteDialogProps) {
  const getToken = useTokenGetter()
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false)
  const [errorBanner, setErrorBanner] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handleClose = () => {
    setErrorBanner(null)
    onClose()
  }

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!presentation) return
    setIsDeleting(true)
    setErrorBanner(null)

    try {
      await supplierService.removePackaging(getToken, supplierId, presentation.ingredient.id)
      onDeleted(presentation)
      handleClose()
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 409) {
        setErrorBanner(error.message)
      } else {
        setErrorBanner(
          error instanceof ApiError
            ? error.message
            : 'No pudimos quitar la presentación. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentar.'
        )
      }
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false)
    }
  }

  if (!presentation) return null

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => { if (!nextOpen && !isDeleting) handleClose() }}>
      <DialogPortal>
        <DialogBackdrop />
        <DialogPopup className="max-w-md text-left">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-900/40 dark:text-rose-400">
              <AlertTriangle className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <DialogTitle className="text-lg leading-snug">
                ¿Quitar presentación de {presentation.ingredient.name}?
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-1 text-xs">
                El insumo deja de tener esta presentación de este proveedor.
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>

          {presentation.isDefault && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 p-3 text-xs text-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-200">
              <Star className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>
                Esta presentación es la <strong>predeterminada</strong>. Si existen otras presentaciones cargadas para este insumo, deberás seleccionar otra como predeterminada antes de poder quitarla.
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {errorBanner && (
            <div role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300">
              <p>{errorBanner}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row">
            <DialogClose
              disabled={isDeleting}
              className="min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 transition hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
            >
              Cancelar
            </DialogClose>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDelete}
              disabled={isDeleting}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-rose-700 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isDeleting ? (
                <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              {isDeleting ? 'Quitando...' : 'Sí, quitar'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </DialogPopup>
      </DialogPortal>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/[id]/components/SupplierPresentationsList.test.tsx">
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import type { SupplierPresentation } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { SupplierPresentationsList } from './SupplierPresentationsList'

vi.mock('next/link', () => ({
  default: ({ children, href, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; href: string; className?: string }) => (
    <a href={href} className={className}>
      {children}
    </a>
  ),
}))

/** Nombre largo como los del catálogo de la cuenta Demo del recorrido del 10/11 ("Cacao…"). */
const CACAO = 'Cacao amargo en polvo alcalinizado para repostería Bahía Blanca'

const presentaciones: SupplierPresentation[] = [
  {
    id: 'si-cacao',
    supplierCode: 'CAC220',
    rawDescription: 'CACAO AMARGO ALCALINO EN POLVO BOLSA X 25 KG MARCA BAHIA',
    packageSize: 25,
    packageUnit: 'kg',
    packagePrice: 412500,
    isDefault: false,
    ingredient: { id: 'ing-cacao', name: CACAO, unit: 'kg' },
  },
  {
    id: 'si-harina',
    supplierCode: 'HAR188',
    rawDescription: 'HARINA SARITA 000 X 25 KG',
    packageSize: 25,
    packageUnit: 'kg',
    packagePrice: 18406.25,
    isDefault: true,
    ingredient: { id: 'ing-harina', name: 'Harina de trigo 000', unit: 'kg' },
  },
]

function renderLista() {
  const handlers = { onEdit: vi.fn(), onDelete: vi.fn(), onMakeDefault: vi.fn() }
  render(<SupplierPresentationsList presentations={presentaciones} {...handlers} />)
  return handlers
}

const filaDe = (nombre: string) =>
  screen.getAllByRole('listitem').find((li) => within(li).queryByText(nombre)) as HTMLElement

describe('SupplierPresentationsList - retoques visuales (#362)', () => {
  it('Escenario Gherkin: Nombres completos -> un insumo de nombre largo se lee completo y tiene tooltip', () => {
    renderLista()
    const nombre = screen.getByText(CACAO)
    const clases = nombre.className.split(/\s+/)
    expect(clases).not.toContain('truncate')
    expect(clases).toContain('break-words')
    expect(nombre).toHaveAttribute('title', CACAO)
  })

  it('la etiqueta En cuarentena baja de renglón en lugar de recortar el nombre', () => {
    renderLista()
    const nombre = screen.getByText('Harina de trigo 000')
    expect(nombre.parentElement?.className.split(/\s+/)).toContain('flex-wrap')
  })

  it('la descripción de la lista del proveedor también tiene tooltip con el texto completo', () => {
    renderLista()
    const descripcion = screen.getByText('CACAO AMARGO ALCALINO EN POLVO BOLSA X 25 KG MARCA BAHIA')
    expect(descripcion).toHaveAttribute('title', 'CACAO AMARGO ALCALINO EN POLVO BOLSA X 25 KG MARCA BAHIA')
  })

  it('la estrella vacía "Usar como predeterminada" responde al pasar el mouse en claro y en oscuro, muestra el foco y llama a la acción', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const { onMakeDefault } = renderLista()
    const boton = within(filaDe(CACAO)).getByRole('button', { name: `Usar como predeterminada la presentación de ${CACAO}` })
    expect(boton).toHaveAttribute('title', 'Usar como predeterminada')
    expect(boton.className.split(/\s+/)).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        'hover:border-indigo-300',
        'hover:bg-indigo-50',
        'hover:text-indigo-700',
        'dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40',
        'focus-visible:outline-2',
      ])
    )
    await user.click(boton)
    expect(onMakeDefault).toHaveBeenCalledWith(presentaciones[0])
  })

  it('la presentación que ya es predeterminada tiene la estrella llena y no ofrece el botón', () => {
    renderLista()
    const fila = filaDe('Harina de trigo 000')
    expect(within(fila).getByRole('img', { name: 'Presentación predeterminada' })).toHaveAttribute('title', 'Presentación predeterminada')
    expect(within(fila).queryByRole('button', { name: /Usar como predeterminada/ })).toBeNull()
  })
})

describe('SupplierPresentationsList - Escenario "Tabla legible" (#434)', () => {
  it('cada dato va en su columna, con los nombres unificados y la columna Acciones', () => {
    renderLista()
    const encabezado = screen.getByTestId('supplier-presentations-header')
    expect([...encabezado.children].map((c) => c.textContent)).toEqual([
      'Insumo',
      'Presentación',
      'Precio del bulto',
      'Costo por unidad',
      'Código',
      'Acciones',
    ])

    const celdas = [...filaDe(CACAO).children].map((c) => c.textContent ?? '')
    expect(celdas).toHaveLength(6)
    expect(celdas[1]).toContain('25 kg')
    expect(celdas[2]).toContain('$412.500,00')
    expect(celdas[3]).toContain('$16.500,00')
    expect(celdas[4]).toContain('CAC220')
  })

  it('una presentación sin código lo dice en su columna', () => {
    render(
      <SupplierPresentationsList
        presentations={[{ ...presentaciones[0]!, supplierCode: null, rawDescription: null }]}
        onEdit={vi.fn()}
        onDelete={vi.fn()}
        onMakeDefault={vi.fn()}
      />
    )
    expect([...filaDe(CACAO).children][4]).toHaveTextContent('Sin código')
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SupplierDeleteDialog.test.tsx">
import { render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type SupplierDetail, type SupplierSummary } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { SupplierDeleteDialog } from './SupplierDeleteDialog'

const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token')
const auth = vi.hoisted(() => ({ newTokenGetterEachRender: false }))

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({
    getToken: auth.newTokenGetterEachRender ? vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token') : getToken,
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: {
    getById: vi.fn(),
    remove: vi.fn(),
    update: vi.fn(),
  },
}))

const molino: SupplierSummary = {
  id: 'sup-1',
  accountId: 'acc-1',
  name: 'Molino Olavarriense',
  contactPhone: null,
  email: null,
  address: null,
  isActive: true,
  ingredientCount: 3,
  quarantineCount: 1,
}

const detail: SupplierDetail = {
  ...molino,
  ingredients: [
    {
      id: 'si-1',
      supplierCode: 'HAR-000',
      packageSize: '50',
      packageUnit: 'kg',
      packagePrice: '35000',
      isDefault: true,
      isQuarantined: false,
      ingredient: { id: 'ing-1', name: 'Harina de trigo 000', unit: 'kg' },
    },
    {
      id: 'si-2',
      supplierCode: null,
      packageSize: '25',
      packageUnit: 'kg',
      packagePrice: '18406.25',
      isDefault: false,
      isQuarantined: true,
      ingredient: { id: 'ing-2', name: 'Harina integral', unit: 'kg' },
    },
    {
      id: 'si-3',
      supplierCode: 'SAL-1',
      packageSize: '1',
      packageUnit: 'kg',
      packagePrice: '950',
      isDefault: false,
      isQuarantined: false,
      ingredient: { id: 'ing-3', name: 'Sal fina', unit: 'kg' },
    },
  ],
}

const renderDialog = (props: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof SupplierDeleteDialog>> = {}) => {
  const handlers = { onClose: vi.fn(), onDeleted: vi.fn(), onDeactivated: vi.fn() }
  render(<SupplierDeleteDialog open supplier={molino} {...handlers} {...props} />)
  return handlers
}

describe('SupplierDeleteDialog', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    auth.newTokenGetterEachRender = false
  })

  it('pide el detalle una sola vez aunque getToken cambie de referencia entre renders', async () => {
    auth.newTokenGetterEachRender = true
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue(detail)
    renderDialog()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: /Presentaciones afectadas/ })
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50))
    expect(supplierService.getById).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin: la confirmación muestra las tres presentaciones afectadas antes de aceptar', async () => {
    let resolveDetail: (value: SupplierDetail) => void = () => {}
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockReturnValue(new Promise((resolve) => { resolveDetail = resolve }))
    renderDialog()

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: '¿Dar de baja a Molino Olavarriense?' })
    const confirm = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' })
    expect(confirm).toBeDisabled()
    expect(within(dialog).getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Buscando las presentaciones afectadas...')

    resolveDetail(detail)

    const list = await within(dialog).findByRole('list', { name: 'Presentaciones afectadas (3)' })
    const items = within(list).getAllByRole('listitem')
    expect(items).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(items[0]).toHaveTextContent('Harina de trigo 000')
    expect(items[0]).toHaveTextContent('50 kg · $35.000')
    expect(items[1]).toHaveTextContent('25 kg · $18.406,25')
    expect(items[2]).toHaveTextContent('Sal fina')
    expect(confirm).toBeEnabled()
    expect(supplierService.getById).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function), 'sup-1')
  })

  it('marca la presentación predeterminada y la retenida, y explica qué pasa con el costo y las listas', async () => {
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue(detail)
    renderDialog()

    const list = await screen.findByRole('list', { name: /Presentaciones afectadas/ })
    const [harina, integral] = within(list).getAllByRole('listitem')
    expect(within(harina).getByText('Predeterminada')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(harina).getByText('Cód. HAR-000')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(integral).getByText('En cuarentena')).toBeInTheDocument()

    // #434: una sola frase, sin repetir los nombres que ya están en la lista.
    expect(
      screen.getByText(
        'Los insumos en los que este proveedor es predeterminado mantienen su costo actual, pero quedan sin proveedor predeterminado hasta que elijas otro.'
      )
    ).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Harina de trigo 000 conserva/)).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.getByText('Las listas de precios de este proveedor ya no van a actualizar estos insumos.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/1 precio en cuarentena se descarta/)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('al confirmar da de baja y avisa a la pantalla', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue(detail)
    vi.mocked(supplierService.remove).mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    const { onDeleted } = renderDialog()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: /Presentaciones afectadas/ })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(onDeleted).toHaveBeenCalledWith(molino))
    expect(supplierService.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function), 'sup-1')
  })

  it('un proveedor sin presentaciones aclara que no afecta a ningún insumo', async () => {
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue({ ...detail, ingredients: [] })
    renderDialog({ supplier: { ...molino, ingredientCount: 0, quarantineCount: 0 } })

    expect(await screen.findByText('No tiene presentaciones cargadas: ningún insumo se ve afectado.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Desactivar en su lugar/ })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('si no puede traer las presentaciones no deja confirmar y permite reintentar', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))
    renderDialog()

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('No pudimos traer las presentaciones de este proveedor.')
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' })).toBeDisabled()

    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValueOnce(detail)
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reintentar' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Presentaciones afectadas (3)' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' })).toBeEnabled()
  })

  it('si la baja falla muestra el motivo dentro del diálogo y no cierra', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue(detail)
    vi.mocked(supplierService.remove).mockRejectedValue(new ApiError('Proveedor no encontrado.', 404))
    const { onDeleted, onClose } = renderDialog()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: /Presentaciones afectadas/ })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Proveedor no encontrado.')
    expect(onDeleted).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('ofrece desactivarlo en lugar de borrarlo, sin perder sus presentaciones', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue(detail)
    const deactivated = { ...molino, isActive: false }
    vi.mocked(supplierService.update).mockResolvedValue(deactivated)
    const { onDeactivated } = renderDialog()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: /Presentaciones afectadas/ })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Desactivar en su lugar' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(onDeactivated).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deactivated))
    expect(supplierService.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function), 'sup-1', { isActive: false })
    expect(supplierService.remove).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SupplierDeleteDialog.tsx">
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle, CirclePause, Info, LoaderCircle, PackageOpen, RefreshCw, Star, ShieldAlert, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

import { useTokenGetter } from '@/hooks/useTokenGetter'
import { Dialog, DialogBackdrop, DialogClose, DialogDescription, DialogPopup, DialogPortal, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import { formatPackage, formatPackagePrice } from '@/lib/supplierDisplay'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type Supplier, type SupplierPresentation, type SupplierSummary } from '@/services/supplierService'

interface SupplierDeleteDialogProps {
  open: boolean
  supplier: SupplierSummary | null
  onClose: () => void
  onDeleted: (supplier: SupplierSummary) => void
  onDeactivated: (supplier: Supplier) => void
}

type DetailResult =
  | { key: string; status: 'error' }
  | { key: string; status: 'ready'; presentations: SupplierPresentation[] }

type DetailState = { status: 'loading' } | DetailResult

const errorMessage = (error: unknown, fallback: string) => (error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : fallback)

function PresentationsSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div role="status" className="mt-5 space-y-2">
      <span className="sr-only">Buscando las presentaciones afectadas...</span>
      {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
        <div key={row} aria-hidden="true" className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-3 dark:border-gray-800">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="h-3.5 w-36 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800" />
            <div className="h-3 w-24 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
          </div>
          <div className="h-5 w-20 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function ImpactNotes({ presentations }: { presentations: SupplierPresentation[] }) {
  const hasDefaults = presentations.some((item) => item.isDefault)
  const quarantined = presentations.filter((item) => item.isQuarantined).length

  return (
    <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2 text-xs text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
      {/* Una sola frase (#434): los insumos ya están en la lista, con su estrella. */}
      {hasDefaults && (
        <li className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 p-3 dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
          <Star className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            Los insumos en los que este proveedor es predeterminado mantienen su costo actual, pero quedan sin proveedor predeterminado hasta que elijas otro.
          </span>
        </li>
      )}
      {quarantined > 0 && (
        <li className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-3 dark:bg-amber-950/40">
          <ShieldAlert className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            {quarantined === 1
              ? '1 precio en cuarentena se descarta sin aplicarse.'
              : `${quarantined} precios en cuarentena se descartan sin aplicarse.`}
          </span>
        </li>
      )}
      <li className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-3 dark:bg-gray-800/60">
        <Info className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>Las listas de precios de este proveedor ya no van a actualizar estos insumos.</span>
      </li>
    </ul>
  )
}

/**
 * Confirmación de baja de un proveedor. Antes de habilitar el botón trae `GET /api/suppliers/:id`
 * y lista cada presentación que se borra en cascada (especificación funcional §4), para que el
 * administrador vea qué insumos pierden a este proveedor. Ofrece desactivarlo como alternativa.
 */
export function SupplierDeleteDialog({ open, supplier, onClose, onDeleted, onDeactivated }: SupplierDeleteDialogProps) {
  const getToken = useTokenGetter()
  const [result, setResult] = useState<DetailResult | null>(null)
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0)
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<'delete' | 'deactivate' | null>(null)
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const supplierId = supplier?.id

  // Cada apertura o reintento es un pedido nuevo: hasta que llegue su respuesta, se ve la carga.
  const requestKey = open && supplierId ? `${supplierId}:${reloadKey}` : null
  const detail: DetailState = result && result.key === requestKey ? result : { status: 'loading' }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requestKey || !supplierId) return
    let active = true

    supplierService
      .getById(getToken, supplierId)
      .then((response) => {
        if (active) setResult({ key: requestKey, status: 'ready', presentations: response.ingredients ?? [] })
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) setResult({ key: requestKey, status: 'error' })
      })

    return () => {
      active = false
    }
  }, [requestKey, supplierId, getToken])

  const retry = useCallback(() => setReloadKey((key) => key + 1), [])

  const close = () => {
    setActionError(null)
    onClose()
  }

  if (!supplier) return null

  const isBusy = pendingAction !== null
  const presentations = detail.status === 'ready' ? detail.presentations : []

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setPendingAction('delete')
    setActionError(null)
    try {
      await supplierService.remove(getToken, supplier.id)
      onDeleted(supplier)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setActionError(errorMessage(error, 'No pudimos dar de baja al proveedor. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentar.'))
    } finally {
      setPendingAction(null)
    }
  }

  const handleDeactivate = async () => {
    setPendingAction('deactivate')
    setActionError(null)
    try {
      const updated = await supplierService.update(getToken, supplier.id, { isActive: false })
      onDeactivated(updated)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setActionError(errorMessage(error, 'No pudimos desactivar al proveedor. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentar.'))
    } finally {
      setPendingAction(null)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => { if (!nextOpen && !isBusy) close() }}>
      <DialogPortal>
        <DialogBackdrop />
        <DialogPopup className="max-h-[90dvh] max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] overflow-y-auto text-left md:max-w-lg">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-900/40 dark:text-rose-400">
              <AlertTriangle className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <DialogTitle className="text-lg leading-snug">¿Dar de baja a {supplier.name}?</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-1">
                Se borra el proveedor junto con sus presentaciones. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>

          {detail.status === 'loading' && <PresentationsSkeleton />}

          {detail.status === 'error' && (
            <div role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-sm text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300">
              <p className="font-bold">No pudimos traer las presentaciones de este proveedor.</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Para darlo de baja necesitás ver primero qué insumos se ven afectados.</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={retry}
                className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-rose-700 active:scale-95"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                Reintentar
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {detail.status === 'ready' && presentations.length === 0 && (
            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 p-4 text-sm text-gray-600 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400">
              <PackageOpen className="size-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <p>No tiene presentaciones cargadas: ningún insumo se ve afectado.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {detail.status === 'ready' && presentations.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-5 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in motion-safe:slide-in-from-bottom-1">
              <h3 id="affected-presentations" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Presentaciones afectadas ({presentations.length})
              </h3>
              <ul aria-labelledby="affected-presentations" className="mt-2 max-h-64 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {presentations.map((item) => (
                  <li
                    key={item.id}
                    className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">{item.ingredient.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        {formatPackage(item.packageSize, item.packageUnit)} · {formatPackagePrice(item.packagePrice)}
                      </p>
                      {item.supplierCode && (
                        <p className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Cód. {item.supplierCode}</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1">
                      {item.isDefault && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                          <Star className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                          Predeterminada
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.isQuarantined && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300">
                          <ShieldAlert className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                          En cuarentena
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <ImpactNotes presentations={presentations} />
            </div>
          )}

          {actionError && (
            <div role="alert" className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-800 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300">
              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <p>{actionError}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 md:flex-row">
            <DialogClose
              disabled={isBusy}
              className="min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 transition hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
            >
              Cancelar
            </DialogClose>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDelete}
              disabled={detail.status !== 'ready' || isBusy}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-rose-700 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {pendingAction === 'delete' ? (
                <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              {pendingAction === 'delete' ? 'Dando de baja...' : 'Sí, dar de baja'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {supplier.isActive && detail.status === 'ready' && presentations.length > 0 && (
            <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              ¿Quizás le vuelvas a comprar?{' '}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDeactivate}
                disabled={isBusy}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 font-bold text-indigo-700 underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-indigo-800 disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-indigo-300"
              >
                {pendingAction === 'deactivate' ? (
                  <LoaderCircle className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <CirclePause className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                Desactivar en su lugar
              </button>{' '}
              y conservá sus presentaciones.
            </p>
          )}
        </DialogPopup>
      </DialogPortal>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SupplierFormDialog.test.tsx">
import { act, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type SupplierSummary } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { renderWithDataRouter } from '@/test-utils/renderWithDataRouter'
import { SupplierFormDialog } from './SupplierFormDialog'

const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token')

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: {
    create: vi.fn(),
    update: vi.fn(),
  },
}))

const molino: SupplierSummary = {
  id: 'sup-1',
  accountId: 'acc-1',
  name: 'Molino Olavarriense',
  contactPhone: '+54 9 2284 41-5566',
  email: 'ventas@molinoolavarriense.com.ar',
  address: 'Av. Pringles 1450, Olavarría',
  isActive: true,
  ingredientCount: 4,
  quarantineCount: 0,
}

const renderDialog = (props: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof SupplierFormDialog>> = {}) => {
  const onClose = vi.fn()
  const onSaved = vi.fn()
  const { router } = renderWithDataRouter(
    <SupplierFormDialog open supplier={null} onClose={onClose} onSaved={onSaved} {...props} />,
    '/proveedores'
  )
  return { onClose, onSaved, router }
}

describe('SupplierFormDialog', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin: el alta con nombre y contacto crea el proveedor y lo devuelve a la lista', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const created = { ...molino, id: 'sup-9', name: 'Lácteos La Serenísima Mayorista', address: null, email: null }
    vi.mocked(supplierService.create).mockResolvedValue(created)
    const { onSaved } = renderDialog()

    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Nuevo proveedor' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), '  Lácteos La Serenísima Mayorista ')
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Teléfono/), '(0221) 455-1020')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(onSaved).toHaveBeenCalledWith(created, 'create'))
    expect(supplierService.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function), {
      name: 'Lácteos La Serenísima Mayorista',
      contactPhone: '(0221) 455-1020',
      email: null,
      address: null,
      isActive: true,
    })
  })

  it('el campo Nombre recibe el foco al abrir', async () => {
    renderDialog()

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')).toHaveFocus())
  })

  it('valida mientras se escribe y no envía con errores', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderDialog()

    const name = screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')
    await user.click(name)
    await user.tab()
    expect(await screen.findByText('Escribí el nombre del proveedor.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(name).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true')

    await user.type(name, 'Molino Sur')
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText('Escribí el nombre del proveedor.')).toBeNull())

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Email/), 'ventas@molino')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Revisá el email: tiene que ser como ventas@proveedor.com.ar.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(supplierService.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('muestra el nombre repetido (409) en el propio campo', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.create).mockRejectedValue(new ApiError('Ya existe un proveedor con ese nombre.', 409))
    const { onSaved } = renderDialog()

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Molino Olavarriense')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Ya existe un proveedor con ese nombre.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true')
    expect(onSaved).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('ante un fallo de red muestra el error dentro del diálogo, en español', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.create).mockRejectedValue(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))
    renderDialog()

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Molino Olavarriense')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(
      'No pudimos guardar el proveedor. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentar.'
    )
    expect(screen.queryByText(/failed to fetch/i)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('mientras guarda deshabilita el botón y lo anuncia', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.create).mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {}))
    renderDialog()

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Molino Olavarriense')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    const saving = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Guardando...' })
    expect(saving).toBeDisabled()
  })

  it('la edición precarga los datos, permite desactivar y borrar un campo', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const updated = { ...molino, isActive: false, address: null }
    vi.mocked(supplierService.update).mockResolvedValue(updated)
    const { onSaved } = renderDialog({ supplier: molino })

    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Editar proveedor' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')).toHaveValue('Molino Olavarriense')
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email/)).toHaveValue('ventas@molinoolavarriense.com.ar')

    const status = screen.getByRole('switch', { name: /Proveedor activo/ })
    expect(status).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true')
    await user.click(status)
    expect(status).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'false')

    await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText(/Dirección/))
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar cambios' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(onSaved).toHaveBeenCalledWith(updated, 'update'))
    expect(supplierService.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function), 'sup-1', {
      name: 'Molino Olavarriense',
      contactPhone: '+54 9 2284 41-5566',
      email: 'ventas@molinoolavarriense.com.ar',
      address: null,
      isActive: false,
    })
  })

  it('el alta no muestra el interruptor de estado: todo proveedor nuevo arranca activo', () => {
    renderDialog()

    expect(screen.queryByRole('switch')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('cerrar sin cambios no pide confirmación; con cambios pide descartarlos', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const { onClose } = renderDialog()

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancelar' }))
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Molino')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancelar' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: '¿Descartar cambios?' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Descartar' }))
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })
})

describe('SupplierFormDialog - cambios sin guardar al salir de la pantalla (#364)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('con datos cargados, salir de la pantalla pide confirmación y "Seguir editando" conserva lo escrito', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const { router } = renderDialog()
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Distribuidora Química del Sur')

    await act(async () => {
      await router.navigate('/productos')
    })

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: '¿Descartar cambios?' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe('/proveedores')

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Seguir editando' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: '¿Descartar cambios?' })).not.toBeInTheDocument())
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe('/proveedores')
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')).toHaveValue('Distribuidora Química del Sur')
  })

  it('"Descartar" deja salir de la pantalla', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const { router } = renderDialog()
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Distribuidora Química del Sur')

    await act(async () => {
      await router.navigate('/productos')
    })
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Descartar' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Otra pantalla' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('con datos cargados, cerrar o recargar la pestaña pide confirmación; sin cambios, no', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderDialog({ supplier: molino })

    const sinCambios = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true })
    window.dispatchEvent(sinCambios)
    expect(sinCambios.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)

    await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText(/Teléfono/))
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Teléfono/), '+54 9 2284 41-7788')
    const conCambios = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true })
    window.dispatchEvent(conCambios)
    expect(conCambios.defaultPrevented).toBe(true)
  })

  it('con el diálogo cerrado no bloquea la salida', async () => {
    const { router } = renderDialog({ open: false })

    await act(async () => {
      await router.navigate('/productos')
    })

    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Otra pantalla' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SuppliersList.tsx">
import { useId } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { CircleCheck, CirclePause, Pencil, ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

import { supplierContact } from '@/lib/supplierDisplay'
import type { SupplierSummary } from '@/services/supplierService'

interface SuppliersListProps {
  suppliers: SupplierSummary[]
  onEdit: (supplier: SupplierSummary) => void
  onDelete: (supplier: SupplierSummary) => void
}

const QUARANTINE_HINT =
  'Precios de este proveedor retenidos porque cambiaron demasiado. Esperan que los apruebes o rechaces en Cuarentena.'

// Columnas compartidas por el encabezado y cada fila desde `md`.
const DESKTOP_GRID = 'md:grid md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(0,1.4fr)_7rem_minmax(0,1.1fr)_auto] md:items-center md:gap-4'

const pluralInsumos = (count: number) => `${count} ${count === 1 ? 'insumo' : 'insumos'}`

function StatusBadge({ isActive }: { isActive: boolean }) {
  return isActive ? (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-emerald-600/20 ring-inset dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
      <CircleCheck className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
      Activo
    </span>
  ) : (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-600 ring-1 ring-gray-500/20 ring-inset dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300">
      <CirclePause className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
      Inactivo
    </span>
  )
}

function QuarantineBadge({ count }: { count: number }) {
  const tooltipId = useId()

  if (count === 0) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
        <ShieldCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        Sin precios retenidos
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <span className="group relative inline-flex">
      <Link
        href="/proveedores/cuarentena"
        aria-describedby={tooltipId}
        className="inline-flex min-h-8 items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 ring-1 ring-amber-600/30 ring-inset transition hover:bg-amber-100 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/70"
      >
        <ShieldAlert className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        {count} en cuarentena
      </Link>
      <span
        id={tooltipId}
        role="tooltip"
        className="pointer-events-none invisible absolute bottom-full left-1/2 z-30 mb-2 w-60 -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 px-3 py-2 text-center text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition duration-150 group-focus-within:visible group-focus-within:translate-y-0 group-focus-within:opacity-100 group-hover:visible group-hover:translate-y-0 group-hover:opacity-100 dark:bg-gray-700"
      >
        {QUARANTINE_HINT}
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}

/**
 * Lista responsiva de proveedores: tarjetas apiladas en el celular y filas tipo tabla desde `md`.
 * Es una sola lista en el DOM (no una tabla y unas tarjetas duplicadas), así el lector de pantalla
 * la recorre una vez. Recibe los proveedores ya filtrados: el buscador del Sprint 6 se monta arriba.
 */
export function SuppliersList({ suppliers, onEdit, onDelete }: SuppliersListProps) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={`hidden border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/60 px-5 py-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800/40 dark:text-gray-400 ${DESKTOP_GRID}`}
      >
        <span>Proveedor</span>
        <span>Contacto</span>
        <span>Insumos</span>
        <span>Cuarentena</span>
        <span className="sr-only">Acciones</span>
      </div>

      <ul aria-label="Proveedores" className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
        {suppliers.map((supplier, index) => {
          const contact = supplierContact(supplier)
          const nameId = `supplier-name-${supplier.id}`

          return (
            <li
              key={supplier.id}
              aria-labelledby={nameId}
              style={{ animationDelay: `${Math.min(index, 8) * 40}ms` }}
              className={`flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50/40 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in motion-safe:slide-in-from-bottom-1 motion-safe:fill-mode-both md:px-5 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20 ${DESKTOP_GRID}`}
            >
              <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 md:justify-start">
                <Link
                  href={`/proveedores/${supplier.id}`}
                  id={nameId}
                  className={`truncate text-sm font-bold transition hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 ${
                    supplier.isActive ? 'text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100' : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'
                  }`}
                >
                  {supplier.name}
                </Link>
                <StatusBadge isActive={supplier.isActive} />
              </div>

              <div className="min-w-0 text-sm">
                {contact.primary ? (
                  <>
                    <p className="truncate text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">{contact.primary}</p>
                    {contact.secondary && (
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{contact.secondary}</p>
                    )}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs italic text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Sin datos de contacto</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 md:contents">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                  {pluralInsumos(supplier.ingredientCount)}
                </p>
                <div>
                  <QuarantineBadge count={supplier.quarantineCount} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2 md:justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEdit(supplier)}
                  aria-label={`Editar ${supplier.name}`}
                  title="Editar"
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:text-indigo-700 active:scale-95 md:size-10 md:min-h-0 md:flex-none md:px-0 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 dark:hover:text-indigo-300"
                >
                  <Pencil className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="md:sr-only">Editar</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onDelete(supplier)}
                  aria-label={`Dar de baja ${supplier.name}`}
                  title="Dar de baja"
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 transition hover:bg-rose-50 active:scale-95 md:size-10 md:min-h-0 md:flex-none md:px-0 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="md:sr-only">Dar de baja</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Esqueleto con la misma forma que la lista, para que no salte el diseño al cargar. */
export function SuppliersListSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
    >
      <span className="sr-only">Cargando proveedores...</span>
      <ul aria-hidden="true" className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
        {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
          <li key={row} className={`flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-4 md:px-5 ${DESKTOP_GRID}`}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 md:justify-start">
              <div className="h-4 w-40 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800" />
              <div className="h-5 w-16 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="h-3.5 w-36 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
              <div className="h-3 w-28 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
            </div>
            <div className="h-3.5 w-16 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
            <div className="h-6 w-28 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800" />
            <div className="flex gap-2 md:justify-end">
              <div className="h-11 flex-1 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-gray-100 md:size-10 md:flex-none dark:bg-gray-800" />
              <div className="h-11 flex-1 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-gray-100 md:size-10 md:flex-none dark:bg-gray-800" />
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/cuarentena/page.test.tsx">
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import type { QuarantinedItem } from '@/services/supplierService'
import QuarantinePage from './page'

const fetchItems = vi.fn()
const storeState: { items: QuarantinedItem[]; isLoading: boolean; error: string | null } = {
  items: [],
  isLoading: false,
  error: null,
}

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token'), signOut: vi.fn() }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({
    user: { id: 'u1', role: 'ADMIN', email: 'admin.panaderia@seed.example.test' },
    isLoading: false,
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
  }),
}))

// QuarantineList es el real: el aviso se dispara con el flujo de rechazo completo.
vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('@/services/supplierService')>()
  return {
    ...actual,
    supplierService: { ...actual.supplierService, rejectQuarantine: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) },
  }
})

vi.mock('@/stores/useQuarantineStore', () => ({
  useQuarantineStore: () => ({ ...storeState, fetchItems, removeItemLocally: vi.fn() }),
}))

const manteca: QuarantinedItem = {
  id: 'q-manteca',
  ingredientId: 'ing-manteca',
  supplierId: 'sup-marjuanc',
  packagePrice: 42000,
  packageSize: 10,
  currentPrice: 42000,
  proposedPrice: 71000,
  quarantineReason: 'VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO',
  isDefault: true,
  isQuarantined: true,
  ingredient: { id: 'ing-manteca', name: 'Manteca', currentCost: 4200 },
  supplier: { id: 'sup-marjuanc', name: 'Distribuidora MarJuanC Alimentos' },
}

const tabs = () => within(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Secciones de proveedores' }))

const renderPage = () =>
  render(
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/proveedores/cuarentena']}>
      <QuarantinePage />
    </MemoryRouter>
  )

describe('QuarantinePage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    storeState.items = [manteca]
    storeState.isLoading = false
    storeState.error = null
  })

  it('queda integrada en Proveedores: pestaña Cuarentena activa y Volver lleva a /proveedores', () => {
    renderPage()

    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Volver' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/proveedores')
    expect(tabs().getByRole('link', { name: 'Proveedores' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/proveedores')
    expect(tabs().getByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena, 1 precio retenido' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Manteca').length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(fetchItems).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('no muestra contador en la pestaña mientras carga la bandeja', () => {
    storeState.isLoading = true
    renderPage()

    expect(tabs().getByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    expect(screen.getByText('Cargando bandeja...')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('con la bandeja vacía muestra el estado vacío dentro de la sección', () => {
    storeState.items = []
    renderPage()

    expect(screen.getByText('Bandeja limpia')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(tabs().getByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('si falla la carga muestra el error, sin contador ni estado vacío, y Reintentar vuelve a pedir la bandeja', () => {
    storeState.items = []
    storeState.error = 'No se pudieron cargar los precios en cuarentena.'
    renderPage()

    expect(screen.getByText('Error al cargar la cuarentena')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('No se pudieron cargar los precios en cuarentena.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Bandeja limpia')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(tabs().getByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena' })).toBeInTheDocument()

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reintentar' }))
    expect(fetchItems).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })

  describe('aviso de confirmación', () => {
    const rechazarManteca = async () => {
      renderPage()
      fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByText('Rechazar')[0])
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /sí, rechazar/i }))
      return screen.findByText('Precio rechazado. Se mantiene el costo anterior.')
    }

    it('se cierra con el botón de cerrar', async () => {
      await rechazarManteca()

      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cerrar notificación' }))

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.queryByText('Precio rechazado. Se mantiene el costo anterior.')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
      })
    })

    it('se cierra deslizándolo hacia el costado', async () => {
      const mensaje = await rechazarManteca()
      const aviso = mensaje.closest('.fixed') as HTMLElement

      fireEvent.touchStart(aviso, { touches: [{ clientX: 40 }] })
      fireEvent.touchMove(aviso, { touches: [{ clientX: 200 }] })
      fireEvent.touchEnd(aviso)

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.queryByText('Precio rechazado. Se mantiene el costo anterior.')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
      })
    })
  })
})
</file>
