import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { createMemoryRouter, MemoryRouter, RouterProvider } from 'react-router-dom'
import { vi } from 'vitest'

import InstallPage from './app/instalar/page'
import LoginPage from './app/login/page'
import PrivacyPage from './app/privacidad/page'
import ProfilePage from './app/perfil/page'
import { router } from './routes'

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({
    isLoaded: true,
    isSignedIn: false,
    getToken: vi.fn(),
  }),
  useClerk: () => ({
    signOut: vi.fn(),
  }),
  SignIn: () => <div data-testid="sign-in" />,
}))

vi.mock('@/hooks/useTheme', () => ({
  useTheme: () => ({
    isDark: false,
    toggleTheme: vi.fn(),
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/clerkConfig', () => ({
  isClerkConfigured: true,
  publishableKey: 'pk_test_123',
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({
    user: {
      email: 'demo@margenx.test',
      role: 'ADMIN',
    },
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
    defaultMinMarginPercent: 30,
    isLoading: false,
    refreshUser: vi.fn(),
  }),
}))

describe('Páginas públicas y enlaces de privacidad', () => {
  it('renderiza la política y la guía sin requerir sesión', () => {
    const router = createMemoryRouter([
      { path: '/privacidad', element: <PrivacyPage /> },
      { path: '/instalar', element: <InstallPage /> },
    ], {
      initialEntries: ['/privacidad'],
    })

    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />)

    expect(screen.getByText(/Privacidad y protección de datos/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/Qué datos guarda MargenX/i)).toBeInTheDocument()

    const installRouter = createMemoryRouter([
      { path: '/instalar', element: <InstallPage /> },
    ], {
      initialEntries: ['/instalar'],
    })

    render(<RouterProvider router={installRouter} />)

    expect(screen.getByText(/Instalá MargenX en tu celular o computadora/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('muestra enlaces visibles a la política desde login y perfil', () => {
    const { unmount } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/login']}>
        <LoginPage />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    )
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /política de privacidad/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
    unmount()

    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/perfil']}>
        <ProfilePage />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    )
    // Desde #429 la política está en los pies de Perfil (móvil y escritorio), no en un botón aparte.
    const enlaces = screen.getAllByRole('link', { name: 'Política' })
    expect(enlaces.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    for (const enlace of enlaces) expect(enlace).toHaveAttribute('href', '/privacidad')
  })

  it('documenta el flujo de instalación con pasos de iPhone y Android visibles', () => {
    const router = createMemoryRouter([
      { path: '/instalar', element: <InstallPage /> },
    ], {
      initialEntries: ['/instalar'],
    })

    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />)

    expect(screen.getByText(/Android · Chrome/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/iPhone · Safari/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/Safari es la opción recomendada/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('registra las rutas públicas de privacidad e instalación en el router principal', () => {
    expect(router.routes.some((route) => route.path === '/privacidad')).toBe(true)
    expect(router.routes.some((route) => route.path === '/instalar')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin "Sin jerga" (#436): la política de privacidad no usa términos técnicos', () => {
    const privacyRouter = createMemoryRouter([{ path: '/privacidad', element: <PrivacyPage /> }], {
      initialEntries: ['/privacidad'],
    })

    render(<RouterProvider router={privacyRouter} />)

    const texto = document.body.textContent ?? ''
    for (const termino of [/RBAC/, /tenant/i, /\bslug\b/i, /\bADMIN\b/, /COLLABORATOR/]) {
      expect(texto, `aparece ${termino}`).not.toMatch(termino)
    }
    // Los roles con las palabras de la app, y los proveedores que tratan datos, con su nombre.
    expect(texto).toMatch(/administrador o colaborador/i)
    expect(texto).toMatch(/Clerk/)
    expect(texto).toMatch(/Brevo/)
  })
})
</file>

<file path="backend/tests/postman/run-tests-cuarentena.sh">
#!/bin/bash
# Uso: ./run-tests-cuarentena.sh <token_cuenta_A> [opciones de newman]
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
  echo "Uso: ./run-tests-cuarentena.sh <token_cuenta_A> [opciones de newman]"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -z "${INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-}" ]; then
  echo "Falta la variable de entorno INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET (la misma del .env del backend)."
  echo "Uso: INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<secreto> ./run-tests-cuarentena.sh <token_cuenta_A> [opciones de newman]"
  exit 1
fi

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

newman run "MargenX - Cuarentena API.postman_collection.json" \
  -e "MargenX - Proveedores y Conversiones QA.postman_environment.json" \
  --env-var "token_cuenta_A=$1" \
  --env-var "internalWebhookSecret=$INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET" \
  "${@:2}"
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/__tests__/service-worker.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {
  pwaOptions,
  isApiRequest,
  isAppNavigation,
  OFFLINE_FALLBACK_URL,
} from '../../pwa.config';

type MatchOptions = { url: URL; request: { mode: string }; sameOrigin: boolean };
type Matcher = (options: MatchOptions) => boolean;

const APP_ORIGIN = 'https://dev.margenx.tech';

function navigation(href: string, sameOrigin = true): MatchOptions {
  return { url: new URL(href, APP_ORIGIN), request: { mode: 'navigate' }, sameOrigin };
}

function fetchRequest(href: string, sameOrigin = false): MatchOptions {
  return { url: new URL(href, APP_ORIGIN), request: { mode: 'cors' }, sameOrigin };
}

// workbox-build copia las funciones al sw.js con toString(): no pueden depender
// de nada definido fuera de su propio cuerpo. Se reconstruyen igual que en el build.
function rebuilt(matcher: Matcher): Matcher {
  return new Function(`return (${matcher.toString()})`)() as Matcher;
}

const workbox = pwaOptions.workbox ?? {};
const runtimeCaching = workbox.runtimeCaching ?? [];

describe('Service worker: rutas que nunca se interceptan', () => {
  it.each([
    '/api/products',
    '/api',
    '/login',
    '/login/factor-one',
    '/login/sso-callback?redirect_url=%2Fproductos',
    '/__clerk/v1/client',
    '/dashboard?__clerk_handshake=abc',
    '/productos?__clerk_db_jwt=abc',
  ])('la navegación a %s no recibe la página Sin conexión', (href) => {
    expect(isAppNavigation(navigation(href))).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each(['/', '/dashboard?source=pwa', '/productos', '/productos/7f3c', '/insumos', '/perfil', '/apis-panaderia'])(
    'la navegación a %s sí tiene respaldo Sin conexión',
    (href) => {
      expect(isAppNavigation(navigation(href))).toBe(true);
    },
  );

  it('no responde navegaciones a otro origen (Clerk, dominio de la API)', () => {
    expect(isAppNavigation(navigation('https://clerk.margenx.tech/v1/client', false))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('no trata como navegación los pedidos de recursos', () => {
    expect(isAppNavigation(fetchRequest('/productos', true))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('Service worker: llamadas a la API', () => {
  it.each([
    'https://api.margenx.tech/api/products',
    'https://api-dev.margenx.tech/api/dashboard/summary',
    'http://localhost:3000/api/ingredients?page=2',
  ])('reconoce %s como llamada a la API', (href) => {
    expect(isApiRequest(fetchRequest(href))).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each(['https://clerk.margenx.tech/v1/client', '/assets/index-abc123.js', '/apis-panaderia'])(
    'no confunde %s con la API',
    (href) => {
      expect(isApiRequest(fetchRequest(href))).toBe(false);
    },
  );

  it('el PDF del reporte semanal va por la regla NetworkOnly de la API y no se precachea (#392)', () => {
    const pdf = fetchRequest('https://api.margenx.tech/api/reports/weekly.pdf');
    expect(isApiRequest(pdf)).toBe(true);
    expect(rebuilt(isApiRequest)(pdf)).toBe(true);
    expect(runtimeCaching.find((rule) => (rule.urlPattern as Matcher)(pdf))?.handler).toBe('NetworkOnly');
    expect((workbox.globPatterns ?? []).some((pattern) => pattern.includes('pdf'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('la API va en NetworkOnly y sin ninguna opción de caché', () => {
    const apiRule = runtimeCaching.find((rule) => rule.urlPattern === isApiRequest);
    expect(apiRule?.handler).toBe('NetworkOnly');
    expect(apiRule?.options).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('ninguna regla guarda respuestas en caché en tiempo de ejecución', () => {
    for (const rule of runtimeCaching) {
      expect(rule.handler).toBe('NetworkOnly');
      expect(rule.options?.cacheName).toBeUndefined();
      expect(rule.options?.expiration).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it('la regla de la API va antes que la de navegación', () => {
    const patterns = runtimeCaching.map((rule) => rule.urlPattern);
    expect(patterns.indexOf(isApiRequest)).toBeLessThan(patterns.indexOf(isAppNavigation));
  });
});

describe('Service worker: página Sin conexión', () => {
  it('las navegaciones de la app caen en offline.html cuando falla la red', () => {
    const navigationRule = runtimeCaching.find((rule) => rule.urlPattern === isAppNavigation);
    expect(navigationRule?.handler).toBe('NetworkOnly');
    expect(navigationRule?.options?.precacheFallback?.fallbackURL).toBe(OFFLINE_FALLBACK_URL);
    expect(OFFLINE_FALLBACK_URL).toBe('/offline.html');
  });

  it('no sirve el index.html precacheado para las navegaciones', () => {
    expect(workbox.navigateFallback).toBeNull();
    expect(workbox.directoryIndex).toBeNull();
  });

  it('las funciones siguen funcionando copiadas al sw.js', () => {
    expect(rebuilt(isAppNavigation)(navigation('/productos'))).toBe(true);
    expect(rebuilt(isAppNavigation)(navigation('/api/products'))).toBe(false);
    expect(rebuilt(isAppNavigation)(navigation('/login/factor-one'))).toBe(false);
    expect(rebuilt(isApiRequest)(fetchRequest('https://api.margenx.tech/api/products'))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('Service worker: precache del shell', () => {
  const patterns = workbox.globPatterns ?? [];

  it('precachea HTML, JS, CSS e íconos', () => {
    expect(patterns).toContain('**/*.{js,css,html}');
    expect(patterns).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['favicon.ico', 'icon-*.png', 'apple-touch-icon.png']));
  });

  it('el HTML precacheado es la página Sin conexión, no index.html', () => {
    expect(workbox.globIgnores).toContain('index.html');
  });

  it('no precachea ExcelJS: se descarga solo al pedir la plantilla de insumos', () => {
    expect(workbox.globIgnores).toContain('**/exceljs*.js');
  });

  it('no precachea las capturas de la guía de instalación ni los placeholders', () => {
    expect(patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.includes('*.png') && pattern.startsWith('**'))).toBe(false);
    expect(patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.includes('placeholder') || pattern.includes('guia-instalacion'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('borra el precache de versiones anteriores', () => {
    expect(workbox.cleanupOutdatedCaches).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('Service worker: actualización', () => {
  it('no se aplica sola: espera la confirmación del usuario', () => {
    expect(pwaOptions.registerType).toBe('prompt');
    expect(workbox.skipWaiting).not.toBe(true);
    expect(workbox.clientsClaim).not.toBe(true);
  });

  it('no inyecta un registro propio ni reemplaza el manifest existente', () => {
    expect(pwaOptions.injectRegister).toBe(false);
    expect(pwaOptions.manifest).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('Service worker: Nginx', () => {
  const nginxConf = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'nginx.conf'), 'utf-8');

  it('sirve sw.js sin la caché inmutable de los assets', () => {
    const swBlock = nginxConf.match(/location = \/sw\.js \{([^}]*)\}/);
    expect(swBlock, 'Falta la regla exacta de /sw.js en nginx.conf').not.toBeNull();
    expect(swBlock?.[1]).toMatch(/expires -1;/);
    expect(swBlock?.[1]).not.toMatch(/immutable/);
  });

  it('sirve index.html (fallback de la SPA) revalidando siempre', () => {
    const spaBlock = nginxConf.match(/location \/ \{([^}]*)\}/);
    expect(spaBlock?.[1]).toMatch(/try_files \$uri \$uri\/ \/index\.html;/);
    expect(spaBlock?.[1]).toMatch(/expires -1;/);
  });

  it('sirve offline.html sin caché de un año', () => {
    const offlineBlock = nginxConf.match(/location = \/offline\.html \{([^}]*)\}/);
    expect(offlineBlock, 'Falta la regla exacta de /offline.html en nginx.conf').not.toBeNull();
    expect(offlineBlock?.[1]).toMatch(/expires -1;/);
  });
});

describe('Página Sin conexión (public/offline.html)', () => {
  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'public/offline.html'), 'utf-8');

  it('muestra el título Sin conexión y el botón Reintentar', () => {
    expect(html).toMatch(/<html lang="es">/);
    expect(html).toMatch(/<h1[^>]*>Sin conexión<\/h1>/);
    expect(html).toMatch(/<button[^>]*id="reintentar"[^>]*>Reintentar<\/button>/);
    expect(html).toMatch(/location\.reload\(\)/);
  });

  it('es autónoma: no carga scripts, estilos ni datos externos', () => {
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/<script[^>]*\ssrc=/);
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/<link[^>]*stylesheet/);
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|\/api\//);
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
  });

  it('no muestra datos de costos ni márgenes', () => {
    const visibleText = (html.match(/<main>([\s\S]*)<\/main>/)?.[1] ?? '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ');
    expect(visibleText).toMatch(/Sin conexión/);
    expect(visibleText).not.toMatch(/\$\s?\d|\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s?%|\bcostos?\b|\bmargen\b|\bmárgenes/i);
  });

  it('es usable a 360 px', () => {
    expect(html).toMatch(/<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/);
    expect(html).toMatch(/min-height:\s*44px/);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/instalar/page.test.tsx">
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import InstallPage from './page'

// La guía usa PublicSessionLink, que lee la sesión con useAuth de Clerk.
// Estas pruebas cubren el contenido de la guía para un visitante sin sesión;
// la versión con sesión ("Ir al panel") la cubre public-session-link.test.tsx.
vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ isLoaded: true, isSignedIn: false }),
}))

const publicDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'public')

const renderInstallPage = () =>
  render(
    <MemoryRouter>
      <InstallPage />
    </MemoryRouter>,
  )

const SECTIONS = ['Android · Chrome', 'iPhone · Safari', 'Escritorio · Chrome o Edge']

describe('Guía de instalación (/instalar)', () => {
  it('no muestra "Captura pendiente" en ninguna sección', () => {
    renderInstallPage()

    expect(screen.queryByText(/captura pendiente/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it.each(SECTIONS)('la sección "%s" tiene una captura con texto alternativo en cada paso', (title) => {
    renderInstallPage()

    const section = screen.getByRole('heading', { name: title }).closest('section')
    expect(section, `No se encontró la sección ${title}`).not.toBeNull()

    const steps = within(section as HTMLElement).getAllByRole('listitem')
    expect(steps.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)

    for (const step of steps) {
      const image = within(step).getByRole('img')
      expect(image.getAttribute('alt')?.trim()).toBeTruthy()
    }
  })

  it('cada captura de la guía existe en public/', () => {
    renderInstallPage()

    const sources = screen.getAllByRole('img').map((image) => image.getAttribute('src') ?? '')
    expect(sources.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)

    for (const src of sources) {
      expect(src.startsWith('/guia-instalacion/'), `Ruta fuera de /guia-instalacion: ${src}`).toBe(true)
      expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(publicDir, src)), `Falta el archivo: ${src}`).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  it('cada captura declara su ancho y alto reales, así no corre la lista al bajar (#398, CLS a 360 px)', () => {
    renderInstallPage()

    for (const image of screen.getAllByRole('img')) {
      const src = image.getAttribute('src') ?? ''
      const png = fs.readFileSync(path.join(publicDir, src))
      // Cabecera PNG: ancho y alto en los bytes 16 a 23.
      expect(image.getAttribute('width'), src).toBe(String(png.readUInt32BE(16)))
      expect(image.getAttribute('height'), src).toBe(String(png.readUInt32BE(20)))
      expect(image, src).toHaveClass('h-auto')
    }
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/insumos/components/SuppliesPageContent.cost.test.tsx">
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import { ingredientService, type Ingredient } from '@/services/ingredientService'
import { supplierService } from '@/services/supplierService'
import SuppliesPageContent from './SuppliesPageContent'
import { renderWithDataRouter } from '@/test-utils/renderWithDataRouter'

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token-de-prueba'), signOut: vi.fn() }),
}))

vi.mock('react-router-dom', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import('react-router-dom')>()),
  useNavigate: () => vi.fn(),
  useLocation: () => ({ pathname: '/insumos' }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({
    user: { id: 'u1', role: 'ADMIN', email: 'admin@panaderia.com' },
    isLoading: false,
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/ingredientService', () => ({
  ingredientService: { getAll: vi.fn(), list: vi.fn(), create: vi.fn() },
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: { getQuarantine: vi.fn() },
}))


/** Respuesta paginada de GET /ingredients con una sola página. */
const pagina = <T,>(items: T[]) => ({
  items,
  meta: { total: items.length, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: items.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 },
})

const HARINA: Ingredient = {
  id: 'ing-1',
  name: 'Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense',
  unit: 'kg',
  currentCost: 736.25,
  updatedAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
}

const renderPage = () => renderWithDataRouter(<SuppliesPageContent />, '/insumos')

/** Abre "Nuevo Insumo", carga Manteca por kg y tipea el costo como lo escribe el comercio. */
async function crearMantecaConCosto(costoTipeado: string) {
  const user = userEvent.setup()
  renderPage()

  // Hay un botón para desktop y otro para mobile: abren el mismo formulario.
  const [nuevoInsumo] = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: /Nuevo Insumo/i })
  await user.click(nuevoInsumo as HTMLElement)
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Nombre del insumo/i), 'Manteca La Serenísima')
  const costo = screen.getByLabelText(/Costo unitario/i)
  await user.type(costo, costoTipeado)
  return { user, costo }
}

describe('SuppliesPageContent - costo escrito en es-AR (#359, [RV377-B1])', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue(pagina([HARINA]))
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getQuarantine).mockResolvedValue([])
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.create).mockImplementation(async (_getToken, input) => ({
      id: 'ing-2',
      updatedAt: '2026-11-14T00:00:00.000Z',
      ...input,
    }))
  })

  it.each([
    ['1.234,56', 1234.56],
    ['1.250', 1250],
    ['7001,35', 7001.35],
  ])('tipear "%s" muestra lo escrito y envía %d', async (tipeado, enviado) => {
    const { user, costo } = await crearMantecaConCosto(tipeado)

    expect(costo).toHaveValue(tipeado)

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear Insumo' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(ingredientService.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    expect(vi.mocked(ingredientService.create).mock.calls[0]?.[1]).toEqual({
      name: 'Manteca La Serenísima',
      unit: 'kg',
      currentCost: enviado,
    })
  })

  it('un costo mal escrito no se envía y avisa en español', async () => {
    const { user } = await crearMantecaConCosto('1.23.4')

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear Insumo' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Escribí el costo con coma decimal, por ejemplo 1.234,56')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(ingredientService.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/insumos/components/SuppliesTableDesktop.tsx">
import type { KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import type { Ingredient } from '@/services/ingredientService'
import { formatUnit } from '@/lib/format'

/**
 * Vista desktop del catálogo de insumos.
 * Muestra la información principal en tabla para pantallas de mayor tamaño,
 * dejando la selección de cada insumo como acción accesible por clic o teclado (Enter/Espacio)
 * para abrir el editor.
 */
interface SuppliesTableDesktopProps {
  supplies: Ingredient[]
  onSelect: (supply: Ingredient) => void
  money: (value: number) => string
}

/**
 * Renderiza la grilla de insumos en formato tabla para pantallas de escritorio.
 * Mantiene el acceso rápido a la información y permite abrir el detalle del item
 * tanto con clic del mouse como mediante navegación con teclado accesible (Enter / Espacio).
 */
export function SuppliesTableDesktop({ supplies, onSelect, money }: SuppliesTableDesktopProps) {
  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTableRowElement>, supply: Ingredient) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
      event.preventDefault()
      onSelect(supply)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
      <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
        <thead className="border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/50 text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800/50 dark:text-gray-100">
          <tr>
            <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Nombre del Insumo</th>
            <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Unidad de Medida</th>
            <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Costo Actual</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
          {supplies.map((supply) => (
            <tr
              key={supply.id}
              tabIndex={0}
              role="button"
              onClick={() => onSelect(supply)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => handleKeyDown(event, supply)}
              className="group cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50/50 focus-visible:bg-indigo-50/70 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-indigo-600 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/20 dark:focus-visible:bg-indigo-950/40"
            >
              <td className="px-5 py-4 font-bold text-gray-900 transition-colors group-hover:text-indigo-600 group-focus-visible:text-indigo-600 dark:text-gray-100 dark:group-hover:text-indigo-400 dark:group-focus-visible:text-indigo-400">
                {/* Sin aria-label: el nombre de la fila sale del texto visible (insumo, unidad y costo), como pide WCAG 2.5.3 (#442). */}
                <span className="sr-only">Ver y editar insumo </span>
                {supply.name}
              </td>
              <td className="px-5 py-4">
                <span className="rounded-lg bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300">
                  {formatUnit(supply.unit)}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-5 py-4 font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                {money(supply.currentCost)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/productos/[id]/components/ProductAddIngredientModal.test.tsx">
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import { ingredientService, type Ingredient } from '@/services/ingredientService'
import { ProductAddIngredientModal } from './ProductAddIngredientModal'

/** La búsqueda espera 300 ms antes de ir a la API: margen para entornos cargados. */
const BUSQUEDA = { timeout: 3000 }

const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token')

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/ingredientService', () => ({
  ingredientService: { list: vi.fn(), create: vi.fn() },
}))

const harina = { id: 'ing-harina', name: 'Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 736.25 } as Ingredient
const sesamo = { id: 'ing-sesamo', name: 'Semillas de sésamo La Molinera', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 5400 } as Ingredient

describe('ProductAddIngredientModal - búsqueda en la API (#350)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('busca "sesamo" en la API y suma el insumo elegido aunque no esté en la despensa cargada', async () => {
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [sesamo],
      meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: 100, totalPages: 1 },
    })
    const onAdd = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} availablePantry={[harina]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={onAdd} />
    )

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i }))
    await user.type(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Filtrar/), 'sesamo')
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Semillas de sésamo La Molinera/ }, BUSQUEDA))

    expect(ingredientService.list).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(getToken, { page: 1, limit: 100, search: 'sesamo' })
    expect(screen.getByText(/Semillas de sésamo La Molinera \(/)).toBeInTheDocument()

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Sumar a la receta|Agregar/i }))
    expect(onAdd).toHaveBeenCalledWith(sesamo, expect.any(Number), expect.any(String), expect.any(Number))
  })

  it('sin coincidencias avisa que no hay insumos', async () => {
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [],
      meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 100, totalPages: 0 },
    })
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} availablePantry={[harina]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={vi.fn()} />
    )

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i }))
    await user.type(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Filtrar/), 'azafran')

    expect(screen.getByText('Buscando insumos...')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(await screen.findByText('No se encontraron insumos.', undefined, BUSQUEDA)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})

describe('ProductAddIngredientModal - selector de la receta (#357)', () => {
  const azafran = { id: 'ing-azafran', name: 'Azafrán en hebras', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 85000.5 } as Ingredient

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [],
      meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 100, totalPages: 0 },
    })
  })

  it('no preselecciona un insumo que ya está en la receta y lo muestra como "Ya en la receta"', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} availablePantry={[harina, sesamo]} existingIngredientIds={[harina.id]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={vi.fn()} />
    )

    const trigger = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i })
    expect(trigger).toHaveTextContent('Semillas de sésamo La Molinera')
    expect(trigger).not.toHaveTextContent('Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense')

    await user.click(trigger)
    const repetida = screen.getByRole('option', { name: /Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense/ })
    expect(repetida).toHaveTextContent('Ya en la receta')
    expect(repetida).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true')
    expect(repetida).toBeDisabled()
  })

  it('Escape con la lista abierta cierra solo la lista y el modal sigue abierto', async () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn()
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={onClose} availablePantry={[harina, sesamo]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={vi.fn()} />
    )

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('listbox')).toBeInTheDocument()

    await user.keyboard('{Escape}')

    expect(screen.queryByRole('listbox')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Sumar Insumo a la Receta' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i })).toHaveFocus()
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

    // Con la lista cerrada, Escape sí cierra el modal.
    await user.keyboard('{Escape}')
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('un clic en "Cantidad utilizada" cierra la lista y deja el modal abierto', async () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn()
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={onClose} availablePantry={[harina, sesamo]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={vi.fn()} />
    )

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i }))
    await user.click(screen.getByLabelText('Cantidad utilizada'))

    expect(screen.queryByRole('listbox')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Sumar Insumo a la Receta' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('alta rápida: el insumo creado queda elegido y se puede sumar sin cerrar el modal', async () => {
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.create).mockResolvedValue(azafran)
    const onClose = vi.fn()
    const onAdd = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    const onIngredientCreated = vi.fn()
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    render(
      <ProductAddIngredientModal isOpen onClose={onClose} availablePantry={[harina]} existingIngredientIds={[harina.id]} isLoadingSupplies={false} onAdd={onAdd} onIngredientCreated={onIngredientCreated} />
    )

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i }))
    await user.type(screen.getByPlaceholderText(/Filtrar/), 'Azafrán en hebras')
    // "Crear" aparece recién cuando termina la búsqueda (#432).
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('option', { name: '+ Crear nuevo insumo' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Nuevo insumo' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre del insumo')).toHaveValue('Azafrán en hebras')
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Costo unitario/), '85000,50')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear Insumo' }))

    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(onIngredientCreated).toHaveBeenCalledWith(azafran))
    expect(ingredientService.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(getToken, { name: 'Azafrán en hebras', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 85000.5 })
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Nuevo insumo' })).not.toBeInTheDocument())
    expect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Seleccionar Insumo/i })).toHaveTextContent('Azafrán en hebras')
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Agregar/i }))
    expect(onAdd).toHaveBeenCalledWith(azafran, expect.any(Number), expect.any(String), expect.any(Number))
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/[id]/components/SupplierPresentationsList.tsx">
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { Pencil, ShieldAlert, Star, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

import { formatPackage, formatPackagePrice } from '@/lib/supplierDisplay'
import { formatUnit } from '@/lib/format'
import type { SupplierPresentation } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES } from '@/lib/accessibility'

interface SupplierPresentationsListProps {
  presentations: SupplierPresentation[]
  onEdit: (presentation: SupplierPresentation) => void
  onDelete: (presentation: SupplierPresentation) => void
  onMakeDefault: (presentation: SupplierPresentation) => void
}

/**
 * Columnas fijas en escritorio (#434): insumo, presentación, precio del bulto, costo por unidad,
 * código y acciones. El insumo es la más ancha y se lee completo (#362). En el celular, cada fila
 * es una tarjeta con los mismos datos en el mismo orden.
 */
const DESKTOP_GRID =
  'md:grid md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2.2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.1fr)_minmax(0,1.1fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)_auto] md:items-center md:gap-4'

const ICON_BUTTON = 'inline-flex min-h-11 min-w-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-xl border bg-white transition dark:bg-gray-800'

export function SupplierPresentationsList({
  presentations,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onMakeDefault,
}: SupplierPresentationsListProps) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        data-testid="supplier-presentations-header"
        className={`hidden border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/60 px-5 py-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800/40 dark:text-gray-400 ${DESKTOP_GRID}`}
      >
        <span>Insumo</span>
        <span>Presentación</span>
        <span>Precio del bulto</span>
        <span>Costo por unidad</span>
        <span>Código</span>
        <span className="text-right">Acciones</span>
      </div>

      <ul aria-label="Presentaciones mayoristas" className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
        {presentations.map((item) => {
          const numSize = Number(item.packageSize) || 1
          const numPrice = Number(item.packagePrice) || 0
          const unitCost = numPrice / numSize

          return (
            <li
              key={item.id}
              className={`flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50/40 md:px-5 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20 ${DESKTOP_GRID}`}
            >
              <div className="min-w-0">
                {/* El nombre no se recorta: baja de renglón, y la etiqueta de cuarentena pasa abajo si no entra (#362). */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
                  <p
                    title={item.ingredient.name}
                    className="min-w-0 break-words text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100"
                  >
                    {item.ingredient.name}
                  </p>
                  {item.isQuarantined && (
                    <Link
                      href="/proveedores/cuarentena"
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 ring-1 ring-amber-600/30 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300"
                    >
                      <ShieldAlert className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                      En cuarentena
                    </Link>
                  )}
                </div>
                {item.rawDescription && (
                  <p title={item.rawDescription} className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    {item.rawDescription}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500 md:hidden dark:text-gray-400">Presentación: </span>
                {formatPackage(item.packageSize, item.packageUnit)}
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500 md:hidden dark:text-gray-400">Precio del bulto: </span>
                {formatPackagePrice(item.packagePrice)}
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500 md:hidden dark:text-gray-400">Costo por unidad: </span>
                {formatPackagePrice(unitCost)} / {formatUnit(item.packageUnit)}
              </div>

              <div className="min-w-0 text-xs">
                {item.supplierCode ? (
                  <p className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    <span className="font-sans font-normal text-gray-500 md:hidden dark:text-gray-400">Código: </span>
                    {item.supplierCode}
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <span className="inline-block rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-500 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400">
                    Sin código
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 md:justify-end">
                {item.isDefault ? (
                  <span
                    role="img"
                    aria-label="Presentación predeterminada"
                    title="Presentación predeterminada"
                    className="inline-flex min-h-11 min-w-11 items-center justify-center text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300"
                  >
                    <Star className="size-5 fill-current" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  !item.isQuarantined && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onMakeDefault(item)}
                      aria-label={`Usar como predeterminada la presentación de ${item.ingredient.name}`}
                      title="Usar como predeterminada"
                      className={`${ICON_BUTTON} border-gray-200 text-gray-500 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:hover:text-indigo-300 ${CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES}`}
                    >
                      <Star className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </button>
                  )
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEdit(item)}
                  aria-label={`Editar presentación de ${item.ingredient.name}`}
                  title="Editar presentación"
                  className={`${ICON_BUTTON} border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-300 ${CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES}`}
                >
                  <Pencil className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onDelete(item)}
                  aria-label={`Quitar presentación de ${item.ingredient.name}`}
                  title="Quitar presentación"
                  className={`${ICON_BUTTON} border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 ${CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES}`}
                >
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SupplierFormDialog.tsx">
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { AlertTriangle, LoaderCircle, Truck, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'

import { useTokenGetter } from '@/hooks/useTokenGetter'
import { Dialog, DialogBackdrop, DialogClose, DialogDescription, DialogPortal, DialogSheet, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import { UnsavedChangesDialog } from '@/components/unsaved-changes-dialog'
import { useUnsavedChangesWarning } from '@/hooks/useUnsavedChangesWarning'
import { supplierSchema, toSupplierPayload, type SupplierFormInput } from '@/schemas/supplierSchema'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type Supplier } from '@/services/supplierService'

export type SupplierSaveMode = 'create' | 'update'

interface SupplierFormDialogProps {
  open: boolean
  /** `null` abre el alta; un proveedor abre su edición. */
  supplier: Supplier | null
  onClose: () => void
  onSaved: (supplier: Supplier, mode: SupplierSaveMode) => void
}

const EMPTY_VALUES: SupplierFormInput = { name: '', contactPhone: '', email: '', address: '', isActive: true }

const toFormValues = (supplier: Supplier | null): SupplierFormInput =>
  supplier
    ? {
        name: supplier.name,
        contactPhone: supplier.contactPhone ?? '',
        email: supplier.email ?? '',
        address: supplier.address ?? '',
        isActive: supplier.isActive,
      }
    : EMPTY_VALUES

const inputClass =
  'mt-1.5 h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border bg-gray-50 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 outline-none transition placeholder:font-normal placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-white dark:placeholder-gray-500 dark:focus:bg-gray-800'
const inputState = (hasError: boolean) =>
  hasError
    ? 'border-rose-400 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/20 dark:border-rose-500/70'
    : 'border-gray-200 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-600/20 dark:border-gray-700 dark:focus:border-indigo-500'

function FieldError({ id, message }: { id: string; message?: string }) {
  if (!message) return null
  return (
    <p id={id} className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in dark:text-rose-400">
      <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
      {message}
    </p>
  )
}

/**
 * Alta y edición de un proveedor en un bottom sheet (ventana centrada desde `md`).
 * Valida con Zod al salir de cada campo y en vivo después; el 409 de nombre repetido
 * se muestra en el campo y cualquier otro error queda dentro del diálogo, nunca tapado.
 */
export function SupplierFormDialog({ open, supplier, onClose, onSaved }: SupplierFormDialogProps) {
  const getToken = useTokenGetter()
  const isEdit = supplier !== null
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showDiscard, setShowDiscard] = useState(false)

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    reset,
    setValue,
    setError,
    control,
    formState: { errors, isDirty, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<SupplierFormInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(supplierSchema),
    mode: 'onTouched',
    defaultValues: toFormValues(supplier),
  })

  const isActive = useWatch({ control, name: 'isActive' })

  // Con el diálogo abierto y cambios sin guardar, salir de la pantalla o cerrar la pestaña pide confirmación (#364).
  const {
    showDialog: showLeaveConfirm,
    confirmNavigation: confirmLeave,
    cancelNavigation: cancelLeave,
  } = useUnsavedChangesWarning(open && isDirty && !isSubmitting)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) reset(toFormValues(supplier))
  }, [open, supplier, reset])

  const close = () => {
    setSubmitError(null)
    setShowDiscard(false)
    onClose()
  }

  const requestClose = () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return
    if (isDirty) {
      setShowDiscard(true)
      return
    }
    close()
  }

  const onSubmit = async (values: SupplierFormInput) => {
    setSubmitError(null)
    const payload = toSupplierPayload(values)

    try {
      const saved = isEdit
        ? await supplierService.update(getToken, supplier.id, payload)
        : await supplierService.create(getToken, payload)
      onSaved(saved, isEdit ? 'update' : 'create')
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 409) {
        setError('name', { type: 'server', message: error.message }, { shouldFocus: true })
        return
      }
      setSubmitError(
        error instanceof ApiError
          ? error.message
          : 'No pudimos guardar el proveedor. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentar.'
      )
    }
  }

  const { ref: nameFieldRef, ...nameField } = register('name')

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => { if (!nextOpen) requestClose() }}>
        <DialogPortal>
          <DialogBackdrop />
          <DialogSheet initialFocus={nameRef}>
            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 h-1.5 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-200 md:hidden dark:bg-gray-700" aria-hidden="true" />

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate className="flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="flex shrink-0 items-start justify-between gap-3 pb-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                    <Truck className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <DialogTitle className="text-xl">{isEdit ? 'Editar proveedor' : 'Nuevo proveedor'}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription className="mt-0.5">
                      {isEdit
                        ? 'Actualizá cómo contactarlo o si todavía le comprás.'
                        : 'Solo el nombre es obligatorio. El contacto te sirve para pedirle mercadería.'}
                    </DialogDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <DialogClose
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="cursor-pointer rounded-full p-2 text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:bg-gray-800"
                  aria-label="Cerrar"
                >
                  <X className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                </DialogClose>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2 custom-scrollbar space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="supplier-name" className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    Nombre
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="supplier-name"
                    {...nameField}
                    ref={(element) => {
                      nameFieldRef(element)
                      nameRef.current = element
                    }}
                    autoComplete="organization"
                    placeholder="Ej. Molino Olavarriense"
                    aria-invalid={errors.name ? 'true' : 'false'}
                    aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'supplier-name-error' : undefined}
                    className={`${inputClass} ${inputState(!!errors.name)}`}
                  />
                  <FieldError id="supplier-name-error" message={errors.name?.message} />
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="supplier-phone" className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                      Teléfono <span className="font-normal text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">(opcional)</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="supplier-phone"
                      {...register('contactPhone')}
                      type="tel"
                      inputMode="tel"
                      autoComplete="tel"
                      placeholder="Ej. +54 9 2284 41-5566"
                      aria-invalid={errors.contactPhone ? 'true' : 'false'}
                      aria-describedby={errors.contactPhone ? 'supplier-phone-error' : undefined}
                      className={`${inputClass} ${inputState(!!errors.contactPhone)}`}
                    />
                    <FieldError id="supplier-phone-error" message={errors.contactPhone?.message} />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="supplier-email" className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                      Email <span className="font-normal text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">(opcional)</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="supplier-email"
                      {...register('email')}
                      type="email"
                      inputMode="email"
                      autoComplete="email"
                      placeholder="Ej. ventas@proveedor.com.ar"
                      aria-invalid={errors.email ? 'true' : 'false'}
                      aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'supplier-email-error' : undefined}
                      className={`${inputClass} ${inputState(!!errors.email)}`}
                    />
                    <FieldError id="supplier-email-error" message={errors.email?.message} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="supplier-address" className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    Dirección <span className="font-normal text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">(opcional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="supplier-address"
                    {...register('address')}
                    autoComplete="street-address"
                    placeholder="Ej. Av. Pringles 1450, Olavarría"
                    aria-invalid={errors.address ? 'true' : 'false'}
                    aria-describedby={errors.address ? 'supplier-address-error' : undefined}
                    className={`${inputClass} ${inputState(!!errors.address)}`}
                  />
                  <FieldError id="supplier-address-error" message={errors.address?.message} />
                </div>

                {isEdit && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800/60">
                    <div>
                      <p id="supplier-active-label" className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                        Proveedor activo
                      </p>
                      <p id="supplier-active-hint" className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        {isActive
                          ? 'Sus listas de precios actualizan tus costos.'
                          : 'Queda guardado, pero sus listas de precios no se aplican.'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      role="switch"
                      aria-checked={isActive}
                      aria-labelledby="supplier-active-label"
                      aria-describedby="supplier-active-hint"
                      onClick={() => setValue('isActive', !isActive, { shouldDirty: true })}
                      className={`relative inline-flex h-7 w-12 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-indigo-600 ${
                        isActive ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={`inline-block size-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform duration-200 ${
                          isActive ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                        }`}
                      />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {submitError && (
                  <div
                    role="alert"
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-800 motion-safe:animate-in motion-safe:fade-in motion-safe:slide-in-from-top-1 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300"
                  >
                    <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <p>{submitError}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 flex shrink-0 gap-3 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={requestClose}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 transition hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
                >
                  Cancelar
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-indigo-700 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-70"
                >
                  {isSubmitting && <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
                  {isSubmitting ? 'Guardando...' : isEdit ? 'Guardar cambios' : 'Crear proveedor'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </DialogSheet>
        </DialogPortal>
      </Dialog>

      <UnsavedChangesDialog
        open={showDiscard}
        onConfirm={close}
        onCancel={() => setShowDiscard(false)}
      />
      <UnsavedChangesDialog open={showLeaveConfirm} onConfirm={confirmLeave} onCancel={cancelLeave} />
    </>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/components/SuppliersPageContent.test.tsx">
import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { supplierService, type SupplierSummary } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { renderWithDataRouter } from '@/test-utils/renderWithDataRouter'
import SuppliersPageContent from './SuppliersPageContent'

const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token')

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken, signOut: vi.fn() }),
}))

const currentUser = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  value: {
    id: 'u1',
    role: 'ADMIN' as 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR',
    email: 'admin.panaderia@seed.example.test',
    account: { id: 'acc-1', businessName: 'Panadería Central', slug: 'panaderia-central' as string | undefined },
  },
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({
    user: currentUser.value,
    isLoading: false,
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: {
    getAll: vi.fn(),
    getById: vi.fn(),
    create: vi.fn(),
    update: vi.fn(),
    remove: vi.fn(),
  },
}))

const molino: SupplierSummary = {
  id: 'sup-1',
  accountId: 'acc-1',
  name: 'Molino Olavarriense',
  contactPhone: '+54 9 2284 41-5566',
  email: null,
  address: null,
  isActive: true,
  ingredientCount: 3,
  quarantineCount: 1,
}

const quimica: SupplierSummary = {
  id: 'sup-2',
  accountId: 'acc-1',
  name: 'Distribuidora Química del Sur',
  contactPhone: null,
  email: 'compras@quimicadelsur.com.ar',
  address: null,
  isActive: true,
  ingredientCount: 2,
  quarantineCount: 0,
}

const renderPage = () => renderWithDataRouter(<SuppliersPageContent />, '/proveedores')

const supplierList = () => screen.getByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })

describe('SuppliersPageContent', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.value.role = 'ADMIN'
    currentUser.value.account.slug = 'panaderia-central'
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockResolvedValue([quimica, molino])
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin: la bandeja de cuarentena se elige desde las pestañas de Proveedores', async () => {
    renderPage()

    const tabs = within(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Secciones de proveedores' }))
    expect(tabs.getByRole('link', { name: 'Proveedores' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    // Sin lista cargada todavía no se conoce cuántos precios hay retenidos.
    expect(tabs.getByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/proveedores/cuarentena')

    expect(await tabs.findByRole('link', { name: 'Cuarentena, 1 precio retenido' })).toHaveAttribute(
      'href',
      '/proveedores/cuarentena'
    )
  })

  it('muestra al administrador la dirección de ingesta de su comercio, aun sin proveedores cargados', async () => {
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockResolvedValueOnce([])
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByText('Todavía no cargaste proveedores')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('precios-panaderia-central@margenx.tech')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copiar dirección' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('no muestra la dirección si la cuenta no trae slug (la API no se lo envía al colaborador)', async () => {
    currentUser.value.role = 'COLLABORATOR'
    currentUser.value.account.slug = undefined
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })
    expect(screen.queryByText(/@margenx\.tech/)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Copiar dirección' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('muestra el esqueleto mientras carga y después la lista ordenada con el resumen', async () => {
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise(() => {}))
    const { unmount } = renderPage()
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Cargando proveedores...')
    unmount()

    renderPage()
    const rows = within(await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })).getAllByRole('listitem')
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'))).toEqual(['supplier-name-sup-2', 'supplier-name-sup-1'])
    expect(screen.getByText('Proveedores activos').nextSibling).toHaveTextContent('2')
    expect(screen.getByText('Insumos vinculados').nextSibling).toHaveTextContent('5')
    expect(screen.getByText('Precios en cuarentena').nextSibling).toHaveTextContent('1')
  })

  it('sin proveedores invita a cargar el primero y abre el alta', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockResolvedValue([])
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByText('Todavía no cargaste proveedores')).toBeInTheDocument()
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar mi primer proveedor' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Nuevo proveedor' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('si la carga falla muestra el error con Reintentar y recupera la lista', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))
    renderPage()

    const alert = await screen.findByRole('alert')
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent('No se pudieron cargar los proveedores.')
    expect(screen.queryByText(/failed to fetch/i)).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Proveedores activos')).toBeNull()

    await user.click(within(alert).getByRole('button', { name: 'Reintentar' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alert')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('muestra el mensaje del servidor cuando la API responde con error', async () => {
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getAll).mockRejectedValueOnce(new ApiError('No tenés permisos para esta acción.', 403))
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('No tenés permisos para esta acción.')
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin: al completar nombre y contacto y confirmar, el proveedor aparece en la lista', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    const created = {
      id: 'sup-3',
      accountId: 'acc-1',
      name: 'Avícola San Cayetano',
      contactPhone: '0221 455-1020',
      email: null,
      address: null,
      isActive: true,
    }
    vi.mocked(supplierService.create).mockResolvedValue(created)
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })
    await user.click(screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Nuevo proveedor' })[0])
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre'), 'Avícola San Cayetano')
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(/Teléfono/), '0221 455-1020')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Crear proveedor' }))

    const row = await within(supplierList()).findByRole('listitem', { name: 'Avícola San Cayetano' })
    expect(within(row).getByText('0 insumos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(row).getByText('0221 455-1020')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(await screen.findByText('Proveedor "Avícola San Cayetano" creado')).toBeInTheDocument()
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Nuevo proveedor' })).toBeNull())
  })

  it('la edición actualiza la fila y conserva sus contadores', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.update).mockResolvedValue({ ...molino, name: 'Molino Olavarriense S.A.' })
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Editar Molino Olavarriense' }))
    const name = screen.getByLabelText('Nombre')
    await user.clear(name)
    await user.type(name, 'Molino Olavarriense S.A.')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar cambios' }))

    const row = await within(supplierList()).findByRole('listitem', { name: 'Molino Olavarriense S.A.' })
    expect(within(row).getByText('3 insumos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(within(row).getByText('1 en cuarentena')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(await screen.findByText('Cambios guardados en "Molino Olavarriense S.A."')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('la baja confirmada quita al proveedor de la lista y lo avisa', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue({ ...quimica, ingredients: [] })
    vi.mocked(supplierService.remove).mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dar de baja Distribuidora Química del Sur' }))
    await screen.findByText('No tiene presentaciones cargadas: ningún insumo se ve afectado.')
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sí, dar de baja' }))

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(within(supplierList()).queryByRole('listitem', { name: 'Distribuidora Química del Sur' })).toBeNull()
    )
    expect(await screen.findByText('Diste de baja a "Distribuidora Química del Sur"')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('desactivar en lugar de borrar deja al proveedor como Inactivo', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getById).mockResolvedValue({
      ...molino,
      ingredients: [
        {
          id: 'si-1',
          packageSize: '50',
          packageUnit: 'kg',
          packagePrice: '35000',
          isDefault: true,
          ingredient: { id: 'ing-1', name: 'Harina de trigo 000', unit: 'kg' },
        },
      ],
    })
    vi.mocked(supplierService.update).mockResolvedValue({ ...molino, isActive: false })
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByRole('list', { name: 'Proveedores' })
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dar de baja Molino Olavarriense' }))
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Desactivar en su lugar' }))

    const row = await within(supplierList()).findByRole('listitem', { name: 'Molino Olavarriense' })
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(row).getByText('Inactivo')).toBeInTheDocument())
    expect(within(row).getByText('3 insumos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(await screen.findByText('"Molino Olavarriense" quedó inactivo')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
