<file path="frontend/src/app/dashboard/components/DashboardKpiCards.test.tsx">
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import type { DashboardMetrics } from '@/services/dashboardService'
import { DashboardKpiCards } from './DashboardKpiCards'

const metricas: DashboardMetrics = {
  activeIngredientsCount: 218,
  criticalProductsCount: 119,
  healthyProductsCount: 170,
  averageMarginPercent: 38.5,
  recentCostVariationsCount: 7,
  lossCount: 12,
  riskCount: 107,
  targetCount: 130,
  surplusCount: 40,
  draftCount: 50,
}

function margenPromedio() {
  return screen.getByTestId('average-margin')
}

describe('DashboardKpiCards: margen mediano (#351, #430)', () => {
  it('un margen positivo se muestra en verde', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(margenPromedio()).toHaveTextContent('38,5 %')
    expect(margenPromedio().className).toMatch(/text-emerald-700/)
    expect(margenPromedio().className).not.toMatch(/rose/)
  })

  it('un margen negativo se muestra en rojo y no en verde', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={{ ...metricas, averageMarginPercent: -12.4 }} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(margenPromedio()).toHaveTextContent('-12,4 %')
    expect(margenPromedio().className).toMatch(/text-rose-700/)
    expect(margenPromedio().className).not.toMatch(/emerald/)
  })

  it('un margen de 0 % no se pinta como ganancia ni como pérdida', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={{ ...metricas, averageMarginPercent: 0 }} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(margenPromedio()).toHaveTextContent('0,0 %')
    expect(margenPromedio().className).not.toMatch(/emerald|rose/)
  })

  it('se llama "Margen mediano" y explica qué significa la mediana (#430)', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(screen.getByText('Margen mediano')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('La mitad de tus productos gana más que esto y la mitad menos.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText(/margen promedio/i)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('la tarjeta suma Pérdida y En riesgo de todo el catálogo sin usar el nombre de un estado (#358)', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(screen.getByTestId('critical-count')).toHaveTextContent('119')
    expect(screen.getByText('Productos debajo de su mínimo')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Pérdida o En riesgo')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText(/productos en riesgo/i)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('con un solo producto debajo de su mínimo el rótulo va en singular', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={{ ...metricas, criticalProductsCount: 1 }} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(screen.getByTestId('critical-count')).toHaveTextContent('1')
    expect(screen.getByText('Producto debajo de su mínimo')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('los rótulos de las tarjetas no usan gris 400 sobre blanco (contraste menor a 4,5:1)', () => {
    const { container } = render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    const textoClaroBajo = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('p, span')).filter((el) =>
      el.className.split(/\s+/).includes('text-gray-400')
    )
    expect(textoClaroBajo.map((el) => el.textContent)).toEqual([])
  })
})

describe('DashboardKpiCards en el celular (#362)', () => {
  it('Escenario: las tres KPI se ven a 360 px como las tarjetas de Proveedores (grilla de tres, sin ocultar ninguna)', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    const tarjetas = screen.getAllByTestId('kpi-card')
    expect(tarjetas).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(tarjetas[0].parentElement?.className.split(/\s+/)).toContain('grid-cols-3')
    for (const tarjeta of tarjetas) {
      expect(tarjeta.className.split(/\s+/)).not.toContain('hidden')
    }
    expect(screen.getByTestId('critical-count')).toHaveTextContent('119')
    expect(screen.getByTestId('active-ingredients')).toHaveTextContent('218')
    expect(screen.getByTestId('average-margin')).toHaveTextContent('38,5 %')
  })

  it('un margen largo (por ejemplo "-12,4 %") baja de renglón dentro de la tarjeta en lugar de desbordarla', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={{ ...metricas, averageMarginPercent: -12.4 }} isLoading={false} />)
    for (const id of ['critical-count', 'active-ingredients', 'average-margin']) {
      expect(screen.getByTestId(id).className.split(/\s+/)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['wrap-anywhere', 'text-lg']))
    }
    for (const tarjeta of screen.getAllByTestId('kpi-card')) {
      expect(tarjeta.className.split(/\s+/)).toContain('min-w-0')
    }
  })

  it('cada tarjeta tiene un rótulo corto para el celular y el completo desde la tableta', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(screen.getByText('Debajo de su mínimo').className).toMatch(/md:hidden/)
    expect(screen.getByText('Productos debajo de su mínimo').className).toMatch(/hidden md:inline/)
    expect(screen.getByText('Insumos activos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Margen mediano')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('las aclaraciones largas no se pierden para el lector de pantalla en el celular', () => {
    render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={metricas} isLoading={false} />)
    for (const texto of ['Pérdida o En riesgo', 'La mitad de tus productos gana más que esto y la mitad menos.']) {
      const clases = screen.getByText(texto).className
      expect(clases).toMatch(/\bsr-only\b/)
      expect(clases).toMatch(/md:not-sr-only/)
    }
  })

  it('mientras carga muestra tres esqueletos también en el celular', () => {
    const { container } = render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={null} isLoading />)
    const esqueletos = container.querySelectorAll('.animate-pulse')
    expect(esqueletos).toHaveLength(3)
    for (const esqueleto of esqueletos) {
      expect(esqueleto.className.split(/\s+/)).not.toContain('hidden')
    }
  })

  it('sin métricas (falla de la API) no dibuja tarjetas en cero', () => {
    const { container } = render(<DashboardKpiCards metrics={null} isLoading={false} />)
    expect(container).toBeEmptyDOMElement()
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/dashboard/components/HealthDistributionHistogram.test.tsx">
import { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import type { DashboardMetrics } from '@/services/dashboardService'
import { HealthDistributionHistogram } from './HealthDistributionHistogram'

/** Catálogo grande del recorrido del 10/11 en la cuenta Demo: 339 productos, 50 en borrador. */
const catalogoDemo: DashboardMetrics = {
  activeIngredientsCount: 218,
  criticalProductsCount: 119,
  healthyProductsCount: 170,
  averageMarginPercent: 38.5,
  recentCostVariationsCount: 7,
  lossCount: 12,
  riskCount: 107,
  targetCount: 130,
  surplusCount: 40,
  draftCount: 50,
}

function renderHistograma(metrics: DashboardMetrics | null, onSelectBucket = vi.fn()) {
  render(
    <HealthDistributionHistogram
      metrics={metrics}
      isLoading={false}
      selectedBucket={null}
      onSelectBucket={onSelectBucket}
    />
  )
  return onSelectBucket
}

describe('HealthDistributionHistogram con los buckets del servidor (#351 / #358)', () => {
  it('dibuja los conteos de todo el catálogo: columnas + borradores = 339', () => {
    renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)

    const columnas = {
      loss: screen.getByRole('button', { name: /pérdida ?: 12 productos/i }),
      risk: screen.getByRole('button', { name: /en riesgo ?: 107 productos/i }),
      target: screen.getByRole('button', { name: /en objetivo ?: 130 productos/i }),
      surplus: screen.getByRole('button', { name: /superávit ?: 40 productos/i }),
    }
    const suma = Object.values(columnas)
      .map((col) => Number(within(col).getByTestId('bucket-count').textContent))
      .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)

    expect(suma + catalogoDemo.draftCount).toBe(339)
    expect(screen.getByText('50')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/en borrador \(sin receta\)/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/339 productos en total/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('calcula el porcentaje de cada columna sobre los productos con receta (289)', () => {
    renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)
    const riesgo = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /en riesgo/i })
    // 107 / 289 = 37,02 %
    expect(within(riesgo).getByText('37 %')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('los rótulos dicen que cada producto se compara con su propio mínimo, sin un 30 % fijo', () => {
    renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)

    expect(screen.queryByText(/30\s?%\s?[–-]\s?60/)).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.getByText('Bajo su mínimo')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Su mínimo a 60 %')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText(/cada producto se compara con su propio margen mínimo/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('cada columna muestra el nombre completo del estado en todos los anchos, sin abreviar (#430)', () => {
    renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)

    const nombres = {
      loss: 'Pérdida',
      risk: 'En riesgo',
      target: 'En objetivo',
      surplus: 'Superávit',
    }
    for (const nombre of Object.values(nombres)) {
      const columna = screen.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(`^${nombre} ?:`, 'i') })
      // Un solo rótulo visible por columna: el mismo a 360 px y en escritorio.
      expect(within(columna).getByText(nombre, { exact: true })).toBeInTheDocument()
    }
    expect(screen.queryByText('Riesgo', { exact: true })).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Objetivo', { exact: true })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('el nombre de cada columna sale del texto visible: estado, cantidad, porcentaje y rango (WCAG 2.5.3, axe, #442)', () => {
    renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)

    const riesgo = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^en riesgo ?: 107 productos/i })
    // Con aria-label, el nombre no contenía el porcentaje que se ve en la columna.
    expect(riesgo).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-label')
    // Los ":" van en un texto oculto aparte: happy-dom y Chrome suman un espacio antes, que el lector no pronuncia.
    expect(riesgo).toHaveAccessibleName(/^En riesgo ?: 107 productos, 37\u00a0% del catálogo, Bajo su mínimo$/)
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^superávit ?: 40 productos/i })).toHaveAccessibleName(
      /^Superávit ?: 40 productos, 14\u00a0% del catálogo, > 60\u00a0%$/
    )
  })

  it('al tocar una columna avisa qué bucket filtrar', () => {
    const onSelect = renderHistograma(catalogoDemo)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /en riesgo ?: 107 productos/i }))
    expect(onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('risk')
  })

  it('una columna vacía queda deshabilitada', () => {
    renderHistograma({ ...catalogoDemo, lossCount: 0, criticalProductsCount: 107 })
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /pérdida ?: 0 productos/i })).toBeDisabled()
  })

  it('sin productos con receta muestra el aviso y cuenta los borradores', () => {
    renderHistograma({
      ...catalogoDemo,
      lossCount: 0,
      riskCount: 0,
      targetCount: 0,
      surplusCount: 0,
      draftCount: 3,
      criticalProductsCount: 0,
      healthyProductsCount: 0,
    })
    expect(screen.getByText(/aún no hay productos con receta/i)).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /en riesgo/i })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('sin métricas (falla de la API) no dibuja columnas en cero', () => {
    renderHistograma(null)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /en riesgo/i })).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.queryByText(/distribución de salud financiera/i)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('marca la columna seleccionada y muestra el chip con su nombre unificado y conteo', () => {
    render(
      <HealthDistributionHistogram
        metrics={catalogoDemo}
        isLoading={false}
        selectedBucket="surplus"
        onSelectBucket={vi.fn()}
      />
    )
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /superávit ?: 40 productos/i })).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /filtrando: superávit \(40\)/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('el total del catálogo y los porcentajes no usan gris 400 sobre blanco (contraste menor a 4,5:1)', () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <HealthDistributionHistogram metrics={catalogoDemo} isLoading={false} selectedBucket={null} onSelectBucket={vi.fn()} />
    )
    const conTextoClaroBajo = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('*')).filter((el) =>
      el.className.split(/\s+/).includes('text-gray-400')
    )
    expect(conTextoClaroBajo.map((el) => el.textContent)).toEqual([])
  })

  it('el aviso sin productos con receta tampoco usa gris 400 sobre blanco', () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <HealthDistributionHistogram
        metrics={{ ...catalogoDemo, lossCount: 0, riskCount: 0, targetCount: 0, surplusCount: 0 }}
        isLoading={false}
        selectedBucket={null}
        onSelectBucket={vi.fn()}
      />
    )
    const conTextoClaroBajo = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('*')).filter((el) =>
      el.className.split(/\s+/).includes('text-gray-400')
    )
    expect(conTextoClaroBajo.map((el) => el.textContent)).toEqual([])
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/insumos/components/BulkIngredientsModal.tsx">
'use client'

import { useAuth } from '@clerk/clerk-react'
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  CopyX,
  Download,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  LoaderCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  UploadCloud,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { useId, useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'

import {
  Dialog,
  DialogBackdrop,
  DialogClose,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogSheet,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import {
  BULK_ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS,
  BULK_MAX_ROWS,
  BULK_UNIT_LABELS,
  analyzeIngredientSheet,
  buildBulkPayload,
  describeBatchProblem,
  downloadTemplateFile,
  mapServerErrorsToSheetRows,
  validateSpreadsheetFile,
  type ClassifiedIngredientBatch,
} from '@/lib/bulkIngredients'
import { readSpreadsheet } from '@/lib/spreadsheet'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES } from '@/lib/accessibility'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { ingredientService, type BulkUploadResponse } from '@/services/ingredientService'

interface BulkIngredientsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  existingSupplies: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string }>
  onSuccess: (result: BulkUploadResponse) => void
}

type Stage =
  | { name: 'pick' }
  | { name: 'reading'; fileName: string }
  | { name: 'review'; fileName: string; batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch }
  | { name: 'importing'; fileName: string; batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch }
  | { name: 'done'; fileName: string; batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch; result: BulkUploadResponse }

type TabId = 'valid' | 'duplicates' | 'errors'

const STEP_LABELS = ['Archivo', 'Revisión', 'Resultado'] as const

const FILE_ACCEPT = [
  ...BULK_ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS,
  'text/csv',
  'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
].join(',')

const plural = (count: number, singular: string, pluralForm: string) =>
  `${count} ${count === 1 ? singular : pluralForm}`

function stepIndex(stage: Stage): number {
  if (stage.name === 'done') return 2
  if (stage.name === 'review' || stage.name === 'importing') return 1
  return 0
}

function firstTabWithRows(batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch): TabId {
  if (batch.valid.length > 0) return 'valid'
  if (batch.errors.length > 0) return 'errors'
  return 'duplicates'
}

export function BulkIngredientsModal({ isOpen, onClose, existingSupplies, onSuccess }: BulkIngredientsModalProps) {
  const { getToken } = useAuth()
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>({ name: 'pick' })
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabId>('valid')
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const reset = () => {
    setStage({ name: 'pick' })
    setActiveTab('valid')
    setNotice(null)
  }

  const handleOpenChange = (open: boolean) => {
    if (open || stage.name === 'importing') return
    reset()
    onClose()
  }

  const handleFile = async (file: File) => {
    setNotice(null)
    const fileError = validateSpreadsheetFile(file)
    if (fileError) {
      setNotice(fileError)
      return
    }

    setStage({ name: 'reading', fileName: file.name })
    try {
      const analysis = analyzeIngredientSheet(await readSpreadsheet(await file.arrayBuffer()), existingSupplies)
      if (!analysis.ok) {
        setNotice(describeBatchProblem(analysis.problem))
        setStage({ name: 'pick' })
        return
      }
      setActiveTab(firstTabWithRows(analysis.batch))
      setStage({ name: 'review', fileName: file.name, batch: analysis.batch })
    } catch {
      setNotice('No pudimos leer el archivo. Abrilo en Excel, guardalo como .xlsx o .csv y volvé a subirlo.')
      setStage({ name: 'pick' })
    }
  }

  const handleDownloadTemplate = async () => {
    try {
      await downloadTemplateFile()
    } catch {
      setNotice('No se pudo generar la plantilla. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentarlo.')
    }
  }

  const handleImport = async () => {
    if (stage.name !== 'review' || stage.batch.valid.length === 0) return
    const { fileName, batch } = stage

    setNotice(null)
    setStage({ name: 'importing', fileName, batch })
    try {
      const result = await ingredientService.bulkUpload(getToken, buildBulkPayload(batch.valid))
      setStage({ name: 'done', fileName, batch, result })
      onSuccess(result)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setNotice(
        error instanceof ApiError
          ? error.message
          : 'No pudimos guardar los insumos. Revisá tu conexión y volvé a intentarlo: no se cargó nada.'
      )
      setStage({ name: 'review', fileName, batch })
    }
  }

  const currentStep = stepIndex(stage)

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogPortal>
        <DialogBackdrop />
        <DialogSheet className="flex max-h-[92dvh] flex-col p-0 md:max-h-[85vh] md:max-w-2xl">
          <div className="mx-auto mt-3 h-1.5 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-200 md:hidden dark:bg-gray-700" aria-hidden="true" />

          <header className="flex shrink-0 items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-100 px-5 pb-4 pt-3 md:px-6 md:pt-6 dark:border-gray-800">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
                <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                Carga desde planilla
              </p>
              <DialogTitle className="mt-1 text-xl md:text-2xl">Cargar insumos desde una planilla</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-1 text-sm">
                Revisá cómo queda tu lista antes de guardarla. El archivo se lee en tu dispositivo.
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
            <DialogClose
              disabled={stage.name === 'importing'}
              aria-label="Cerrar carga desde planilla"
              className={cn(
                'flex size-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 transition hover:bg-gray-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700',
                CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES
              )}
            >
              <X className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </DialogClose>
          </header>

          <Stepper current={currentStep} />

          <div className="flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4 md:px-6">
            {notice && (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm font-medium text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200"
              >
                <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                <p>{notice}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {(stage.name === 'pick' || stage.name === 'reading') && (
              <FilePickStep
                isReading={stage.name === 'reading'}
                readingFileName={stage.name === 'reading' ? stage.fileName : null}
                onFile={handleFile}
                onDownloadTemplate={handleDownloadTemplate}
              />
            )}

            {(stage.name === 'review' || stage.name === 'importing') && (
              <ReviewStep
                fileName={stage.fileName}
                batch={stage.batch}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={setActiveTab}
                onChangeFile={reset}
                disabled={stage.name === 'importing'}
              />
            )}

            {stage.name === 'done' && <ResultStep batch={stage.batch} result={stage.result} />}
          </div>

          <footer className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 px-5 pt-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] md:flex-row-reverse md:px-6 dark:border-gray-800">
            {(stage.name === 'review' || stage.name === 'importing') && (
              <PrimaryButton onClick={handleImport} disabled={stage.name === 'importing' || stage.batch.valid.length === 0}>
                {stage.name === 'importing' ? (
                  <>
                    <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                    Guardando insumos…
                  </>
                ) : stage.batch.valid.length === 0 ? (
                  'No hay insumos para importar'
                ) : (
                  `Importar ${plural(stage.batch.valid.length, 'insumo', 'insumos')}`
                )}
              </PrimaryButton>
            )}
            {stage.name === 'done' ? (
              <>
                <PrimaryButton onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}>Listo</PrimaryButton>
                <SecondaryButton onClick={reset}>Cargar otra planilla</SecondaryButton>
              </>
            ) : (
              <SecondaryButton onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)} disabled={stage.name === 'importing'}>
                Cancelar
              </SecondaryButton>
            )}
          </footer>
        </DialogSheet>
      </DialogPortal>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

function Stepper({ current }: { current: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="shrink-0 px-5 pt-4 md:px-6">
      <p className="sr-only">
        Paso {current + 1} de {STEP_LABELS.length}: {STEP_LABELS[current]}
      </p>
      <ol className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" aria-hidden="true">
        {STEP_LABELS.map((label, index) => (
          <li key={label} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <span
              className={cn(
                'h-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors',
                index <= current ? 'bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500' : 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700'
              )}
            />
            <span
              className={cn(
                'text-xs font-semibold',
                index === current ? 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'
              )}
            >
              {label}
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  )
}

interface FilePickStepProps {
  isReading: boolean
  readingFileName: string | null
  onFile: (file: File) => void
  onDownloadTemplate: () => void
}

function FilePickStep({ isReading, readingFileName, onFile, onDownloadTemplate }: FilePickStepProps) {
  const inputId = useId()
  const hintId = useId()
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false)

  const takeFile = (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = ''
    if (file && !isReading) onFile(file)
  }

  const handleDrop = (event: DragEvent<HTMLLabelElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    setIsDragging(false)
    takeFile(event.dataTransfer.files[0])
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/30">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white" aria-hidden="true">
            <Download className="size-5" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-100">1. Descargá la plantilla</h3>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-indigo-900/80 dark:text-indigo-200/80">
              Tres columnas: <strong>Nombre</strong>, <strong>Unidad</strong> (kg, l o u) y <strong>Costo</strong> (ej.
              1.234,56).
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <SecondaryButton onClick={onDownloadTemplate} className="sm:w-auto md:flex-none">
          <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Descargar plantilla
        </SecondaryButton>
      </section>

      <label
        htmlFor={inputId}
        onDragOver={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault()
          setIsDragging(true)
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setIsDragging(false)}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        aria-busy={isReading}
        className={cn(
          'flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-3xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-8 text-center transition',
          'has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-indigo-600 dark:has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-indigo-400',
          isDragging
            ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:bg-indigo-950/40'
            : 'border-gray-300 bg-gray-50/60 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50/40 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800/30 dark:hover:border-indigo-500',
          isReading && 'pointer-events-none'
        )}
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          id={inputId}
          type="file"
          accept={FILE_ACCEPT}
          aria-describedby={hintId}
          disabled={isReading}
          onChange={(event) => takeFile(event.target.files?.[0])}
          className="sr-only"
        />
        <span className="mb-3 flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-300" aria-hidden="true">
          {isReading ? <LoaderCircle className="size-6 animate-spin" /> : <UploadCloud className="size-6" />}
        </span>
        <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white" aria-live="polite">
          {isReading ? `Leyendo ${readingFileName ?? 'la planilla'}…` : '2. Elegí tu planilla'}
        </span>
        <span id={hintId} className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          <span className="hidden md:inline">Arrastrala acá o hacé clic para buscarla. </span>
          <span className="md:hidden">Tocá para elegirla desde tu teléfono o tu Drive. </span>
          Excel (.xlsx, .xls) o CSV, hasta {BULK_MAX_ROWS} insumos.
        </span>
        <span className="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md" aria-hidden="true">
          Buscar archivo
        </span>
      </label>
    </div>
  )
}

interface ReviewStepProps {
  fileName: string
  batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch
  activeTab: TabId
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void
  onChangeFile: () => void
  disabled: boolean
}

function ReviewStep({ fileName, batch, activeTab, onTabChange, onChangeFile, disabled }: ReviewStepProps) {
  const baseId = useId()
  const tabs: Array<{ id: TabId; label: string; count: number; icon: ReactNode; tone: string }> = [
    {
      id: 'valid',
      label: 'Válidas',
      count: batch.valid.length,
      icon: <CheckCircle2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />,
      tone: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
    },
    {
      id: 'duplicates',
      label: 'Repetidas',
      count: batch.duplicates.length,
      icon: <CopyX className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />,
      tone: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
    },
    {
      id: 'errors',
      label: 'Con error',
      count: batch.errors.length,
      icon: <AlertTriangle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />,
      tone: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400',
    },
  ]

  const handleTabKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const index = tabs.findIndex((tab) => tab.id === activeTab)
    const nextIndex: Record<string, number> = {
      ArrowRight: (index + 1) % tabs.length,
      ArrowLeft: (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length,
      Home: 0,
      End: tabs.length - 1,
    }
    const target = nextIndex[event.key]
    if (target === undefined) return
    event.preventDefault()
    const next = tabs[target]
    if (!next) return
    onTabChange(next.id)
    document.getElementById(`${baseId}-tab-${next.id}`)?.focus()
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 py-1 pl-4 pr-1 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4 shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{fileName}</span>
          <span className="shrink-0 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            {plural(batch.totalRows, 'fila', 'filas')}
          </span>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onChangeFile}
          disabled={disabled}
          className={cn(
            'inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 transition hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700',
            CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES
          )}
        >
          <RefreshCw className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Cambiar
        </button>
      </div>

      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Resultado de la revisión" className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const selected = tab.id === activeTab
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              id={`${baseId}-tab-${tab.id}`}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={selected}
              aria-controls={`${baseId}-panel`}
              tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab.id)}
              onKeyDown={handleTabKeyDown}
              className={cn(
                'flex min-h-16 cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border px-1 py-2 transition',
                CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES,
                selected
                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 ring-1 ring-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:ring-indigo-400'
                  : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:hover:bg-gray-700'
              )}
            >
              <span className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 text-xl font-black tabular-nums', tab.tone)}>
                {tab.icon}
                {tab.count}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <div
        id={`${baseId}-panel`}
        role="tabpanel"
        aria-labelledby={`${baseId}-tab-${activeTab}`}
        tabIndex={0}
        className={cn(
          'overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900',
          CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES
        )}
      >
        {activeTab === 'valid' && (
          <RowList empty="Ninguna fila está lista para importar. Revisá las pestañas Repetidas y Con error.">
            {batch.valid.map((row) => (
              <RowItem
                key={row.rowNumber}
                title={row.name}
                meta={`Fila ${row.rowNumber} · ${BULK_UNIT_LABELS[row.unit]}`}
                value={`${row.costFormatted} / ${BULK_UNIT_LABELS[row.unit]}`}
              />
            ))}
          </RowList>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'duplicates' && (
          <RowList empty="No hay nombres repetidos.">
            {batch.duplicates.map((row) => (
              <RowItem
                key={row.rowNumber}
                title={row.name}
                meta={`Fila ${row.rowNumber} · ${BULK_UNIT_LABELS[row.unit]}`}
                detail={row.reason}
                detailTone="text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300"
                value={`${row.costFormatted} / ${BULK_UNIT_LABELS[row.unit]}`}
              />
            ))}
          </RowList>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'errors' && (
          <RowList empty="Ninguna fila tiene errores.">
            {batch.errors.map((row) => (
              <RowItem
                key={row.rowNumber}
                title={row.name}
                meta={`Fila ${row.rowNumber} · Unidad: ${row.rawUnit || '(vacía)'} · Costo: ${row.rawCost || '(vacío)'}`}
                detail={row.reason}
                detailTone="text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300"
              />
            ))}
          </RowList>
        )}
      </div>

      {batch.errors.length > 0 && batch.valid.length > 0 && (
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          Las filas con error no se cargan. Podés importar las válidas ahora y subir las demás cuando las corrijas.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function RowList({ empty, children }: { empty: string; children: ReactNode[] }) {
  if (children.length === 0) {
    return <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">{empty}</p>
  }
  return <ul className="max-h-72 divide-y divide-gray-100 overflow-y-auto dark:divide-gray-800">{children}</ul>
}

interface RowItemProps {
  title: string
  meta: string
  value?: string
  detail?: string
  detailTone?: string
}

function RowItem({ title, meta, value, detail, detailTone }: RowItemProps) {
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{title}</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 wrap-break-word text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">{meta}</p>
        {detail && <p className={cn('mt-1 text-xs font-medium', detailTone)}>{detail}</p>}
      </div>
      {value && (
        <span className="shrink-0 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{value}</span>
      )}
    </li>
  )
}

function ResultStep({ batch, result }: { batch: ClassifiedIngredientBatch; result: BulkUploadResponse }) {
  const serverErrors = mapServerErrorsToSheetRows(result.errors, batch.valid)
  const repeated = batch.duplicates.length + result.skipped
  const withErrors = batch.errors.length + serverErrors.length
  const omitted = repeated + withErrors
  const hasCreated = result.created > 0

  return (
    <div role="status" className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-2 text-center">
        <span
          className={cn(
            'flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl',
            hasCreated
              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400'
              : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400'
          )}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {hasCreated ? <CheckCircle2 className="size-8" /> : <AlertTriangle className="size-8" />}
        </span>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          {hasCreated
            ? `Se ${result.created === 1 ? 'cargó' : 'cargaron'} ${plural(result.created, 'insumo', 'insumos')}`
            : 'No se cargó ningún insumo'}
        </h3>
        <p className="max-w-sm text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          {hasCreated
            ? 'Ya están en tu despensa y podés usarlos en tus recetas.'
            : 'Todas las filas ya existían o tenían errores.'}
        </p>
      </div>

      <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-center dark:border-emerald-900/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30">
          <dt className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">Creados</dt>
          <dd className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200">{result.created}</dd>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-center dark:border-amber-900/50 dark:bg-amber-950/30">
          <dt className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">Omitidos</dt>
          <dd className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">{omitted}</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>

      {omitted > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
          {repeated > 0 && <li>· {plural(repeated, 'repetido', 'repetidos')}: ya estaban en tu despensa o en la planilla.</li>}
          {withErrors > 0 && <li>· {withErrors} con error: corregilos y volvé a subirlos.</li>}
        </ul>
      )}

      {serverErrors.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-900 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-200">
          <p className="font-bold">El servidor rechazó estas filas:</p>
          <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1">
            {serverErrors.map((error, index) => (
              <li key={`${error.rowNumber ?? 'x'}-${index}`}>
                {error.rowNumber ? `Fila ${error.rowNumber}` : 'Fila sin identificar'}
                {error.name ? ` (${error.name})` : ''}: {error.reason}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

interface ButtonProps {
  onClick: () => void
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}

function PrimaryButton({ onClick, disabled, className, children }: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex min-h-12 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-gray-300 disabled:text-gray-600 disabled:shadow-none md:flex-1 dark:disabled:bg-gray-700 dark:disabled:text-gray-300',
        CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES,
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

function SecondaryButton({ onClick, disabled, className, children }: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex min-h-12 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-5 text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:flex-1 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700',
        CANONICAL_FOCUS_CLASSES,
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

          register={vi.fn() as never}
          setValue={vi.fn() as never}
          errors={{ unit: { type: 'server', message: serverMessage } }}
          selectedUnit="litro"
          money={(v) => `$${v}`}
          onNumericKeyDown={vi.fn()}
          onDecimalChange={vi.fn()}
        />
      </MemoryRouter>
    )

    expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(serverMessage)
  })
  describe('textos de la ficha (#433)', () => {
    const props = {
      newOpen: false,
      showDeleteConfirm: false,
      isCollaborator: false,
      onSubmit: vi.fn(),
      onRequestClose: vi.fn(),
      onRequestDelete: vi.fn(),
      onDeleteConfirm: vi.fn(),
      onCancelDelete: vi.fn(),
      onOpenHistory: vi.fn(),
      onOpenPackaging: vi.fn(),
      onEditConnection: vi.fn(),
      onMakeDefault: vi.fn(),
      register: vi.fn() as never,
      setValue: vi.fn() as never,
      errors: {},
      selectedUnit: 'kg' as const,
      money: (v: number) => `$${v}`,
      onNumericKeyDown: vi.fn(),
      onDecimalChange: vi.fn(),
      isLoadingProducts: false,
    }

    it('RC-09: al editar se llama "Editar insumo" y guarda con "Guardar cambios"; en el alta, "Nuevo insumo"', () => {
      const { unmount } = render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <IngredientUpsertSheet {...props} selected={mockIngredient} usedProducts={[]} />
        </MemoryRouter>
      )
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Editar insumo' })).toBeInTheDocument()
      expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Guardar cambios' })).toBeInTheDocument()
      expect(screen.queryByText('Actualizar Costo')).toBeNull()
      unmount()

      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <IngredientUpsertSheet {...props} selected={null} newOpen usedProducts={[]} />
        </MemoryRouter>
      )
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Nuevo insumo' })).toBeInTheDocument()
    })

    it('RC-08: en "Se usa en", el monto dice que es el precio de venta del producto', () => {
      const medialunas: IngredientProductUsage = {
        id: 'prod-medialunas',
        name: 'Medialunas de manteca, docena',
        quantity: 0.6,
        salePrice: 13500,
        cost: 4200,
        marginAmount: 9300,
        marginPercent: 68.89,
        minMarginPercent: 40,
        marginStatus: 'surplus',
        updatedAt: '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z',
      }
      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <IngredientUpsertSheet {...props} selected={mockIngredient} usedProducts={[medialunas]} />
        </MemoryRouter>
      )

      const enlace = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Medialunas de manteca/ })
      expect(enlace).toHaveTextContent('Precio de venta')
      expect(enlace).toHaveTextContent('$13500')
    })

    it('el campo de nombre no se pone blanco al enfocarlo en modo oscuro', () => {
      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <IngredientUpsertSheet {...props} selected={mockIngredient} usedProducts={[]} />
        </MemoryRouter>
      )
      expect(screen.getByLabelText('Nombre del insumo').className).toContain('dark:focus:bg-gray-800')
    })
  })
})

<file path="frontend/src/app/insumos/components/SuppliesPageContent.bulk.test.tsx">
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import { ingredientService, type Ingredient } from '@/services/ingredientService'
import { supplierService } from '@/services/supplierService'
import SuppliesPageContent from './SuppliesPageContent'
import { renderWithDataRouter } from '@/test-utils/renderWithDataRouter'

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token-de-prueba'), signOut: vi.fn() }),
}))

vi.mock('react-router-dom', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import('react-router-dom')>()),
  useNavigate: () => vi.fn(),
  useLocation: () => ({ pathname: '/insumos' }),
}))

const currentUser: { role: 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR' | undefined } = { role: 'ADMIN' }

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({
    user: currentUser.role ? { id: 'u1', role: currentUser.role, email: 'admin@panaderia.com' } : null,
    isLoading: false,
    businessName: 'Panadería Central',
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/ingredientService', () => ({
  ingredientService: { getAll: vi.fn(), list: vi.fn(), bulkUpload: vi.fn() },
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: { getQuarantine: vi.fn() },
}))


/** Respuesta paginada de GET /ingredients con una sola página. */
const pagina = <T,>(items: T[]) => ({
  items,
  meta: { total: items.length, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: items.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 },
})

const HARINA: Ingredient = {
  id: 'ing-1',
  name: 'Harina de trigo 000 Olavarriense',
  unit: 'kg',
  currentCost: 736.25,
  updatedAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
}

const renderPage = () => renderWithDataRouter(<SuppliesPageContent />, '/insumos')

describe('SuppliesPageContent - acceso a la carga desde planilla (#252)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'ADMIN'
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue(pagina([HARINA]))
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.getAll).mockResolvedValue([HARINA])
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getQuarantine).mockResolvedValue([])
  })

  it('el administrador ve el acceso en desktop y en mobile, y abre el diálogo', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderPage()

    const [desktopButton, mobileButton] = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar desde planilla' })
    expect(desktopButton).toBeDefined()
    expect(mobileButton).toBeDefined()

    await user.click(mobileButton as HTMLElement)
    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Cargar insumos desde una planilla' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it.each([
    ['COLLABORATOR', 'COLLABORATOR' as const],
    ['un rol todavía desconocido', undefined],
  ])('no muestra el acceso para %s', async (_caso, role) => {
    currentUser.role = role
    renderPage()

    await waitFor(() => expect(ingredientService.list).toHaveBeenCalled())
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /planilla/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('con la despensa vacía, el administrador ve el atajo para cargarla desde una planilla', async () => {
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue(pagina([]))
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderPage()

    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Cargala desde una planilla' }))

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Cargar insumos desde una planilla' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('la detección de duplicados recibe el catálogo completo, no solo la página visible (#350)', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderPage()

    const [desktopButton] = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar desde planilla' })
    await user.click(desktopButton as HTMLElement)

    await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Cargar insumos desde una planilla' })
    expect(ingredientService.getAll).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('si no se puede leer el catálogo completo, igual abre el diálogo', async () => {
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.getAll).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('network'))
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderPage()

    const [desktopButton] = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar desde planilla' })
    await user.click(desktopButton as HTMLElement)

    expect(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Cargar insumos desde una planilla' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})

describe('SuppliesPageContent - encabezado y tarjetas (#362)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'ADMIN'
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.list).mockResolvedValue(pagina([HARINA]))
    vi.mocked(ingredientService.getAll).mockResolvedValue([HARINA])
    vi.mocked(supplierService.getQuarantine).mockResolvedValue([])
  })

  const encabezado = async () => {
    const titulo = await screen.findByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Insumos' })
    return within(titulo.closest('section') as HTMLElement)
  }

  it('ordena el encabezado: Cuarentena, después las dos altas, con "Nuevo Insumo" (la acción principal) al final', async () => {
    renderPage()
    const botones = (await encabezado()).getAllByRole('button').map((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? b.textContent?.trim())
    expect(botones).toEqual(['Cuarentena', 'Cargar desde planilla', 'Nuevo Insumo'])
  })

  it('"Cargar desde planilla" responde al pasar el mouse en claro y en oscuro, y muestra el foco', async () => {
    renderPage()
    const [desktopButton, mobileButton] = await screen.findAllByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar desde planilla' })
    for (const boton of [desktopButton, mobileButton]) {
      const clases = (boton as HTMLElement).className.split(/\s+/)
      expect(clases).toEqual(
        expect.arrayContaining(['hover:border-indigo-300', 'hover:bg-indigo-50', 'dark:hover:bg-gray-700', 'focus-visible:outline-2'])
      )
    }
  })

  it('quita las tarjetas "Recálculo: Activo" y "Afectan a: Catálogo general", que no informaban nada', async () => {
    renderPage()
    expect(await screen.findByText('Insumos activos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Variaciones recientes')).toBeInTheDocument()
    for (const texto of ['Recálculo', 'Activo', 'Afectan a', 'Catálogo general']) {
      expect(screen.queryByText(texto)).toBeNull()
    }
  })

  it('el colaborador no ve Cuarentena ni la planilla en el encabezado', async () => {
    currentUser.role = 'COLLABORATOR'
    renderPage()
    const botones = (await encabezado()).queryAllByRole('button').map((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? b.textContent?.trim())
    expect(botones).not.toContain('Cuarentena')
    expect(botones).not.toContain('Cargar desde planilla')
  })
})
</file>

import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import { ProductMobileFooter } from './ProductMobileFooter'

describe('ProductMobileFooter (Mobile 360px, #358)', () => {
  it('renderiza el precio, costo, ganancia y badge con estado unificado en la fila de información', () => {
    render(
      <ProductMobileFooter
        isCollaborator={false}
        watchedSalePrice={15000}
        gain={5000}
        cost={10000}
        margin={33.3}
        targetMargin={30}
        itemsCount={3}
        isSaving={false}
        onOpenSimulator={vi.fn()}
      />
    )

    expect(screen.getByText('Precio:')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('$15.000,00')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Ganancia:')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('$5.000,00')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Costo:')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('$10.000,00')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('En objetivo')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Ajustar/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Guardar/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('oculta datos financieros y botones de mutación para rol colaborador', () => {
    render(
      <ProductMobileFooter
        isCollaborator={true}
        watchedSalePrice={15000}
        gain={5000}
        cost={10000}
        margin={33.3}
        targetMargin={30}
        itemsCount={3}
        isSaving={false}
        onOpenSimulator={vi.fn()}
      />
    )

    expect(screen.getByText('Precio:')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('$15.000,00')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Ganancia:')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Costo:')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText(/En objetivo|En riesgo|Pérdida|Superávit|Borrador/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Ajustar/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /Guardar/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('queda apoyada sobre la BottomNav, con la zona segura de iOS (#406)', () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <ProductMobileFooter
        isCollaborator={false}
        watchedSalePrice={15000}
        gain={5000}
        cost={10000}
        margin={33.3}
        targetMargin={30}
        itemsCount={3}
        isSaving={false}
        onOpenSimulator={vi.fn()}
      />
    )

    // La BottomNav mide 3.125rem más su relleno inferior, que incluye la zona segura
    expect(container.querySelector('footer')).toHaveClass(
      'bottom-[calc(3.125rem+max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)))]'
    )
  })
})
