<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/cuarentena/components/QuarantineList.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useAuth } from '@clerk/clerk-react'
import { Check, X, AlertTriangle, LoaderCircle, TrendingUp, TrendingDown } from 'lucide-react'
import type { QuarantinedItem } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { supplierService } from '@/services/supplierService'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { useQuarantineStore } from '@/stores/useQuarantineStore'
import { Dialog, DialogPortal, DialogBackdrop, DialogPopup, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import { formatMoney, formatPercent } from '@/lib/format'

const money = (val: number) => formatMoney(val)

/**
 * Aviso de "Liberar" con los nombres de estado del glosario (especificación funcional §6).
 * `belowMinimum` son los productos que este cambio dejó debajo de su mínimo: En riesgo o Pérdida.
 */
function releaseSummary(affected: number, belowMinimum: number): string {
  if (affected === 0) return 'Precio liberado: no cambia el costo de ningún producto.'
  const affectedText = affected === 1 ? '1 producto afectado' : `${affected} productos afectados`
  const belowText =
    belowMinimum === 0
      ? 'ninguno queda en riesgo ni en pérdida'
      : `${belowMinimum} ${belowMinimum === 1 ? 'queda' : 'quedan'} en riesgo o en pérdida`
  return `Precio liberado: ${affectedText}, ${belowText}.`
}

interface QuarantineListProps {
  items: QuarantinedItem[]
  onShowToast: (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error') => void
}

export function QuarantineList({ items, onShowToast }: QuarantineListProps) {
  const { getToken } = useAuth()
  const { removeItemLocally } = useQuarantineStore()

  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<QuarantinedItem | null>(null)
  const [actionType, setActionType] = useState<'release' | 'reject' | null>(null)
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false)
  // El error se muestra dentro del diálogo: un aviso flotante quedaría tapado por el fondo del modal.
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const openDialog = (item: QuarantinedItem, type: 'release' | 'reject') => {
    setActionError(null)
    setSelectedItem(item)
    setActionType(type)
  }

  const handleAction = async () => {
    if (!selectedItem || !actionType) return
    setIsProcessing(true)
    setActionError(null)
    try {
      if (actionType === 'release') {
        const res = await supplierService.releaseQuarantine(getToken, selectedItem.id)
        onShowToast(releaseSummary(res.affectedProductsCount, res.criticalProducts.length), 'success')
      } else {
        await supplierService.rejectQuarantine(getToken, selectedItem.id)
        onShowToast('Precio rechazado. Se mantiene el costo anterior.', 'success')
      }
      removeItemLocally(selectedItem.id)
      setSelectedItem(null)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      // Solo ApiError trae un mensaje pensado para el usuario; un fallo de red trae el texto técnico del navegador.
      const fallback =
        actionType === 'release'
          ? 'No se pudo liberar el precio. Revisá tu conexión e intentá de nuevo.'
          : 'No se pudo rechazar el precio. Revisá tu conexión e intentá de nuevo.'
      setActionError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : fallback)
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false)
    }
  }

  const getVariationData = (item: QuarantinedItem) => {
    const size = Number(item.packageSize) || 1
    const currentPrice = Number(item.currentPrice ?? item.packagePrice)
    const proposedPrice = Number(item.proposedPrice ?? item.packagePrice)

    const actual = currentPrice / size
    const proposed = proposedPrice / size
    const diff = proposed - actual
    const percent = actual > 0 ? (diff / actual) * 100 : 0
    const isIncrease = percent >= 0

    let reason = 'Variación anormal'
    if (item.quarantineReason === 'COSTO_UNITARIO_INSUFICIENTE' || proposed <= 0.01) {
      reason = 'Costo casi nulo'
    } else if (item.quarantineReason === 'VARIACION_MAYOR_50_POR_CIENTO') {
      reason = isIncrease ? 'Aumento > 50%' : 'Caída > 50%'
    } else if (item.quarantineReason) {
      reason = item.quarantineReason
    } else if (percent > 50) {
      reason = 'Aumento > 50%'
    } else if (percent < -50) {
      reason = 'Caída > 50%'
    }

    return { actual, proposed, percent, reason, isIncrease }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* MOBILE CARDS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:hidden">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const { actual, proposed, percent, reason, isIncrease } = getVariationData(item)
          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-amber-900/50 dark:bg-gray-900"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{item.ingredient.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{item.supplier.name}</p>
                </div>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/50 dark:text-amber-300">
                  {reason}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="my-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-3 text-sm dark:bg-gray-800/50">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase">Actual</p>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-gray-600 line-through dark:text-gray-400">
                    {money(actual)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase">Propuesto</p>
                  <p className="font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{money(proposed)}</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4">
                <span
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold ${
                    isIncrease ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-emerald-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isIncrease ? <TrendingUp className="size-3" /> : <TrendingDown className="size-3" />}
                  {formatPercent(percent, { signed: true })}
                </span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openDialog(item, 'reject')}
                    aria-label={`Rechazar precio propuesto para ${item.ingredient.name}`}
                    className="min-h-11 min-w-11 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer transition"
                  >
                    <X className="size-5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openDialog(item, 'release')}
                    aria-label={`Liberar precio propuesto para ${item.ingredient.name}`}
                    className="min-h-11 min-w-11 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 p-2 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-sm cursor-pointer transition"
                  >
                    <Check className="size-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* DESKTOP TABLE */}
      <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
          <thead className="border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800/50 dark:text-gray-100">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">Insumo / Proveedor</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">Actual</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">Propuesto</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">Variación</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">Motivo</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
            {items.map((item) => {
              const { actual, proposed, percent, reason, isIncrease } = getVariationData(item)
              return (
                <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50/50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/20">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{item.ingredient.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{item.supplier.name}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-500 line-through">{money(actual)}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{money(proposed)}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold ${
                        isIncrease
                          ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/50 dark:text-rose-400'
                          : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/50 dark:text-emerald-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isIncrease ? <TrendingUp className="size-3" /> : <TrendingDown className="size-3" />}
                      {formatPercent(percent, { signed: true })}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <span className="rounded-md bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/50 dark:text-amber-300">
                      {reason}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openDialog(item, 'reject')}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer transition"
                      >
                        <X className="size-3.5" /> Rechazar
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openDialog(item, 'release')}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-sm cursor-pointer transition"
                      >
                        <Check className="size-3.5" /> Liberar
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL DE CONFIRMACIÓN */}
      <Dialog open={!!(selectedItem && actionType)} onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open && !isProcessing) setSelectedItem(null) }}>
        <DialogPortal>
          <DialogBackdrop />
          <DialogPopup>
            <div
              className={`mx-auto mb-4 flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
                actionType === 'release'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 dark:text-indigo-400'
                  : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-900/40 dark:text-rose-400'
              }`}
            >
              {actionType === 'release' ? <Check className="size-7" /> : <AlertTriangle className="size-7" />}
            </div>
            <DialogTitle>
              {actionType === 'release' ? '¿Liberar precio?' : '¿Rechazar precio?'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {actionType === 'release'
                ? selectedItem?.isDefault
                  ? `El costo de ${selectedItem?.ingredient.name} se actualizará y recalculará las recetas afectadas.`
                  : `Se actualizará la presentación de ${selectedItem?.ingredient.name}. No afectará las recetas porque no es la presentación predeterminada.`
                : `El precio anómalo será descartado y ${selectedItem?.ingredient.name} mantendrá su costo actual.`}
            </DialogDescription>
            {actionError && (
              <p
                role="alert"
                className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300"
              >
                <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                {actionError}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
              <DialogClose
                disabled={isProcessing}
                className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition"
              >
                Cancelar
              </DialogClose>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isProcessing}
                onClick={handleAction}
                className={`min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition ${
                  actionType === 'release' ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700' : 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700'
                }`}
              >
                {isProcessing && <LoaderCircle className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
                {actionType === 'release' ? 'Sí, liberar' : 'Sí, rechazar'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </DialogPopup>
        </DialogPortal>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/cuarentena/page.tsx">
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { useAuth } from '@clerk/clerk-react'
import { ShieldAlert, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'
import { Navbar } from '@/components/navbar'
import { BottomNav } from '@/components/bottom-nav'
import { DesktopFooter } from '@/components/desktop-footer'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/empty-state'
import { ErrorState } from '@/components/error-state'
import { ToastAlert } from '@/components/ToastAlert'
import { useQuarantineStore } from '@/stores/useQuarantineStore'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/useToast'
import { SuppliersTabs } from '../components/SuppliersTabs'
import { QuarantineList } from './components/QuarantineList'

export default function QuarantinePage() {
  const { getToken } = useAuth()
  const { items, isLoading, error, fetchItems } = useQuarantineStore()
  const { toast, notify, dismiss: closeToast } = useToast()

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchItems(getToken)
  }, [getToken, fetchItems])

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-950 dark:text-gray-100">
      {toast && <ToastAlert key={toast.id} title={toast.title} type={toast.type} onClose={closeToast} />}

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-md flex-1 flex-col px-4 pt-5 md:max-w-5xl md:px-8 lg:max-w-6xl lg:px-12">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 pb-28 md:pb-12">
          <Navbar title="Cuarentena de Precios" backHref="/proveedores" />

          <SuppliersTabs active="quarantine" quarantineCount={isLoading || error ? undefined : items.length} />

          <section>
            <div className="mb-6">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold md:text-3xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldAlert className="size-6 text-amber-500" />
                Precios en Cuarentena
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Revisá y decidí qué hacer con los precios que MargenX retuvo porque cambiaron demasiado.
              </p>
            </div>

            {isLoading ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-10 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500 shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
                <RefreshCw className="mr-2 size-5 animate-spin" /> Cargando bandeja...
              </div>
            ) : error ? (
              <ErrorState
                title="Error al cargar la cuarentena"
                description={error}
                onRetry={() => fetchItems(getToken)}
              />
            ) : items.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<ShieldAlert className="size-6" />}
                title="Bandeja limpia"
                description="No hay precios retenidos en cuarentena en este momento."
              />
            ) : (
              <QuarantineList items={items} onShowToast={notify} />
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
        <DesktopFooter />
      </div>
      <BottomNav />
    </main>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="backend/src/routes/ingredients.ts">
import { Router, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma';
import { authMiddleware, AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middlewares/auth';
import { AppError } from '../middlewares/errorHandler';
import { blockCollaboratorMutations, requireRole, sanitizeFinancialData } from '../middlewares/rbac';
import {
  DEFAULT_PAGE,
  DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  MAX_LIMIT,
  parsePaginationParams,
  normalizeSearchText,
} from '../utils/pagination';
import { parseArgentineDecimal } from '../utils/argentineNumber';
import {
  applyIngredientCostChange,
  calculateUnitCost,
  classifyProductHealthBucket,
} from '../services/marginCalculator';
import { dispatchMarginAlertEvent } from '../services/marginAlertDispatcher';

const router = Router();

router.use(authMiddleware);
router.use(blockCollaboratorMutations);
router.use(sanitizeFinancialData);

function getIdParam(rawId: string | string[] | undefined): string {
  if (Array.isArray(rawId)) {
    return rawId[0] ?? '';
  }
  return rawId ?? '';
}

const PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS = ['name', 'quantity', 'salePrice', 'cost', 'marginPercent'] as const;
type ProductUsageSortField = (typeof PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS)[number];

interface IngredientProductsPaginationParams {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  sortBy: ProductUsageSortField;
  order: 'asc' | 'desc';
  search: string;
}

function parseIngredientProductsPaginationParams(
  query: Record<string, unknown>
): IngredientProductsPaginationParams {
  const rawPage = Number(query.page);
  const page = Number.isInteger(rawPage) && rawPage > 0 ? rawPage : DEFAULT_PAGE;

  const rawLimit = Number(query.limit);
  const limit =
    Number.isInteger(rawLimit) && rawLimit > 0 ? Math.min(rawLimit, MAX_LIMIT) : DEFAULT_LIMIT;

  const rawSortBy = typeof query.sortBy === 'string' ? query.sortBy : '';
  const sortBy = (PRODUCT_USAGE_SORTABLE_FIELDS as readonly string[]).includes(rawSortBy)
    ? (rawSortBy as ProductUsageSortField)
    : 'name';

  const rawOrder = typeof query.order === 'string' ? query.order.toLowerCase() : '';
  const order = rawOrder === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';

  const rawSearch = typeof query.search === 'string' ? query.search.trim() : '';
  const search = rawSearch.slice(0, 100);

  return { page, limit, sortBy, order, search };
}

function buildIngredientProductsOrderBy(
  sortBy: ProductUsageSortField,
  order: 'asc' | 'desc'
): Prisma.ProductIngredientOrderByWithRelationInput {
  switch (sortBy) {
    case 'quantity':
      return { quantity: order };
    case 'salePrice':
      return { product: { salePrice: order } };
    case 'cost':
      return { product: { cost: order } };
    case 'marginPercent':
      return { product: { marginPercent: order } };
    case 'name':
    default:
      return { product: { name: order } };
  }
}

const VALID_UNITS = ['kg', 'l', 'u'] as const;
type Unit = (typeof VALID_UNITS)[number];
const MAX_MONEY_VALUE = new Prisma.Decimal('99999999.99');
const BULK_MAX_ROWS = 500;

interface IngredientInputDTO {
  name?: unknown;
  unit?: unknown;
  currentCost?: unknown;
}

interface ValidatedIngredientInput {
  name: string;
  unit: Unit;
  currentCost: Prisma.Decimal;
}

function validateIngredientInput(
  body: IngredientInputDTO
): { data: ValidatedIngredientInput } | { errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  const name = typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : '';
  if (!name) {
    errors.push('El campo "name" es obligatorio y debe ser un texto no vacío.');
  }

  const unit = typeof body.unit === 'string' ? body.unit.trim() : '';
  if (!VALID_UNITS.includes(unit as Unit)) {
    errors.push(`El campo "unit" debe ser uno de: ${VALID_UNITS.join(', ')}.`);
  }

  let currentCost: Prisma.Decimal | null = null;
  const rawCost = body.currentCost;

  if (
    rawCost === undefined ||
    rawCost === null ||
    (typeof rawCost === 'string' && rawCost.trim() === '')
  ) {
    errors.push('El campo "currentCost" es obligatorio.');
  } else {
    try {
      const decimalValue = parseArgentineDecimal(rawCost, 'currentCost');
      if (decimalValue.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) {
        errors.push('El campo "currentCost" debe ser mayor a cero.');
      } else if (decimalValue.decimalPlaces() > 2) {
        errors.push('El campo "currentCost" debe ser un valor decimal válido (ej: "742.98").');
      } else if (decimalValue.abs().greaterThan(MAX_MONEY_VALUE)) {
        errors.push('El insumo no puede superar $99.999.999,99.');
      } else {
        currentCost = decimalValue;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push((error as Error).message || 'El campo "currentCost" debe ser un valor decimal válido.');
    }
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return { errors };
  }

  return {
    data: {
      name,
      unit: unit as Unit,
      currentCost: currentCost as Prisma.Decimal,
    },
  };
}

function parseIngredientInput(body: IngredientInputDTO): ValidatedIngredientInput {
  const validation = validateIngredientInput(body);
  if ('errors' in validation) {
    throw new AppError(validation.errors.join(' '), 400);
  }
  return validation.data;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const query = { ...(req.query as Record<string, unknown>) };

  if (req.user!.role === 'COLLABORATOR') {
    const rawSortBy = typeof query.sortBy === 'string' ? query.sortBy : '';
    if (!['name', 'updatedAt'].includes(rawSortBy)) {
      query.sortBy = 'name';
    }
  }

  const { page, limit, sortBy, order, search } = parsePaginationParams(query);
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where: Prisma.IngredientWhereInput = { accountId };
  if (search) {
    const normalized = normalizeSearchText(search);
    where.OR = [
      { searchName: { contains: normalized, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    ];
  }

  const [data, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.ingredient.findMany({
      where,
      omit: { searchName: true },
      include: {
        suppliers: {
          include: {
            supplier: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: order },
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.ingredient.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);

  return res.status(200).json({
    data,
    meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages },
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id                                            */
/* Incluye presentaciones de proveedores asociadas para rol ADMIN.     */
/* (RBAC sanitizeFinancialData limpia 'suppliers' para COLLABORATOR)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    omit: { searchName: true },
    include: {
      suppliers: {
        include: {
          supplier: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  return res.status(200).json({ ingredient });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id/history                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id/history', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const history = await prisma.priceHistory.findMany({
    where: { ingredientId: id },
    orderBy: { changedAt: 'asc' },
  });

  return res.status(200).json({ history });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* GET /api/ingredients/:id/products                                   */
/* Lista paginada de productos cuya receta utiliza el insumo.          */
/* Solo ADMIN; acotado estrictamente por accountId.                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.get('/:id/products', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!ingredient) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const { page, limit, sortBy, order, search } = parseIngredientProductsPaginationParams(
    req.query as Record<string, unknown>
  );
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where: Prisma.ProductIngredientWhereInput = {
    ingredientId: id,
    product: {
      accountId,
      ...(search
        ? {
            OR: [
              { searchName: { contains: normalizeSearchText(search), mode: 'insensitive' } },
              { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
            ],
          }
        : {}),
    },
  };

  const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.productIngredient.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        quantity: true,
        product: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            salePrice: true,
            cost: true,
            marginAmount: true,
            marginPercent: true,
            minMarginPercent: true,
            updatedAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: buildIngredientProductsOrderBy(sortBy, order),
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.productIngredient.count({ where }),
  ]);

  const data = rows.map((row) => {
    const marginStatus = classifyProductHealthBucket(
      new Prisma.Decimal(row.product.marginPercent ?? 0),
      new Prisma.Decimal(row.product.minMarginPercent ?? 0),
      1
    );

    return {
      id: row.product.id,
      name: row.product.name,
      quantity: row.quantity,
      salePrice: row.product.salePrice,
      cost: row.product.cost,
      marginAmount: row.product.marginAmount,
      marginPercent: row.product.marginPercent,
      minMarginPercent: row.product.minMarginPercent,
      marginStatus,
      updatedAt: row.product.updatedAt,
    };
  });

  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);

  return res.status(200).json({
    data,
    meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages },
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* POST /api/ingredients                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.post('/', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const { name, unit, currentCost } = parseIngredientInput(req.body as IngredientInputDTO);

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { accountId, name: { equals: name, mode: 'insensitive' } },
  });
  if (existing) {
    throw new AppError('Ya existe un insumo con ese nombre.', 409);
  }

  const ingredient = await prisma.ingredient.create({
    omit: { searchName: true },
    data: {
      name,
      searchName: normalizeSearchText(name),
      unit,
      currentCost,
      accountId,
    },
  });

  return res.status(201).json({ ingredient });
});

/**
 * Carga masiva de insumos por planilla.
 */
router.post('/bulk', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const rawPayload = req.body as unknown;
  const rows: unknown[] = Array.isArray(rawPayload)
    ? rawPayload
    : Array.isArray((rawPayload as { rows?: unknown[] } | null)?.rows)
      ? (rawPayload as { rows: unknown[] }).rows
      : [];

  if (!Array.isArray(rawPayload) && !Array.isArray((rawPayload as { rows?: unknown[] } | null)?.rows)) {
    throw new AppError('La carga masiva debe enviarse como un array de filas.', 400);
  }

  if (rows.length > BULK_MAX_ROWS) {
    throw new AppError(
      `La lista supera el tope de ${BULK_MAX_ROWS} filas por lote. Dividila en varios lotes más pequeños.`,
      413
    );
  }

  const errors: Array<{ row: number; reason: string }> = [];
  const validRows: Array<{ name: string; searchName: string; unit: Unit; cost: Prisma.Decimal }> = [];
  const existingNames = new Set(
    (await prisma.ingredient.findMany({
      where: { accountId },
      select: { name: true },
    })).map((row) => row.name.trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  const seenInBatch = new Set<string>();
  let skipped = 0;

  for (const [index, row] of rows.entries()) {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') {
      errors.push({ row: index + 1, reason: 'La fila debe contener un objeto con nombre, unidad y costo.' });
      continue;
    }

    const candidate = row as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = String(candidate.name ?? candidate.nombre ?? '').trim();
    const unit = String(candidate.unit ?? candidate.unidad ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const rawCost = candidate.cost ?? candidate.costo ?? candidate.currentCost;
    const normalizedName = name.toLowerCase();

    const validationErrors: string[] = [];

    if (!name) {
      validationErrors.push('El campo "name" es obligatorio y debe ser un texto no vacío.');
    }

    if (!VALID_UNITS.includes(unit as Unit)) {
      validationErrors.push(`El campo "unit" debe ser uno de: ${VALID_UNITS.join(', ')}.`);
    }

    let parsedCost: Prisma.Decimal | null = null;
    if (rawCost === undefined || rawCost === null || (typeof rawCost === 'string' && rawCost.trim() === '')) {
      validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" es obligatorio.');
    } else {
      try {
        const decimalValue = parseArgentineDecimal(rawCost, 'cost');
        if (decimalValue.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) {
          validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" debe ser mayor a cero.');
        } else if (decimalValue.decimalPlaces() > 2) {
          validationErrors.push('El campo "cost" debe ser un valor decimal válido (ej: "742.98").');
        } else if (decimalValue.abs().greaterThan(MAX_MONEY_VALUE)) {
          validationErrors.push('El insumo no puede superar $99.999.999,99.');
        } else {
          parsedCost = decimalValue;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        validationErrors.push((error as Error).message || 'El campo "cost" debe ser un valor decimal válido.');
      }
    }

    if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
      errors.push({ row: index + 1, reason: validationErrors.join(' ') });
      continue;
    }

    if (existingNames.has(normalizedName) || seenInBatch.has(normalizedName)) {
      skipped += 1;
      continue;
    }

    validRows.push({ name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), unit: unit as Unit, cost: parsedCost! });
    seenInBatch.add(normalizedName);
  }

  const transactionResult = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    for (const item of validRows) {
      await tx.ingredient.create({
        data: {
          name: item.name,
          searchName: item.searchName,
          unit: item.unit,
          currentCost: item.cost,
          accountId,
        },
      });
    }

    return validRows.length;
  });

  return res.status(200).json({
    created: transactionResult,
    skipped,
    errors,
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* PUT /api/ingredients/:id                                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/**
 * Qué hacer con la presentación predeterminada cuando el ADMIN cambia a mano el costo del insumo (#427, ADR-011):
 * - `update-presentation`: el precio del bulto pasa a costo × tamaño del bulto, para que siga dando el costo nuevo.
 * - `clear-default`: la presentación deja de ser la predeterminada y el insumo queda con el costo manual.
 */
const DEFAULT_PRESENTATION_ACTIONS = ['update-presentation', 'clear-default'] as const;
type DefaultPresentationAction = (typeof DEFAULT_PRESENTATION_ACTIONS)[number];

function parseDefaultPresentationAction(body: unknown): DefaultPresentationAction | null {
  const raw = (body as { defaultPresentationAction?: unknown } | null)?.defaultPresentationAction;
  if (raw === undefined || raw === null) return null;
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !(DEFAULT_PRESENTATION_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(raw)) {
    throw new AppError('El campo "defaultPresentationAction" tiene que ser "update-presentation" o "clear-default".', 400);
  }
  return raw as DefaultPresentationAction;
}

function safeUnitCost(packagePrice: Prisma.Decimal, packageSize: Prisma.Decimal): Prisma.Decimal | null {
  try {
    return calculateUnitCost(packagePrice, packageSize);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

router.put('/:id', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  if (!req.is('application/json')) {
    throw new AppError('El header Content-Type debe ser application/json.', 400);
  }

  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      unit: true,
      currentCost: true,
      _count: {
        select: {
          products: true,
          suppliers: true,
        },
      },
      // La presentación predeterminada, para avisar si el costo manual la contradice (#427).
      suppliers: {
        where: { isDefault: true },
        take: 1,
        select: {
          id: true,
          packageSize: true,
          packageUnit: true,
          packagePrice: true,
          supplier: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const { _count, suppliers: defaultPresentations, ...existingIngredient } = existing;
  const { name, unit, currentCost } = parseIngredientInput(req.body as IngredientInputDTO);
  const defaultPresentationAction = parseDefaultPresentationAction(req.body);

  if (unit !== existing.unit) {
    const recipesCount = _count?.products ?? 0;
    const presentationsCount = _count?.suppliers ?? 0;
    if (recipesCount > 0 || presentationsCount > 0) {
      throw new AppError(
        `No se puede cambiar la unidad: el insumo está en ${recipesCount} receta(s) y ${presentationsCount} presentación(es) de proveedor. Sacalo de las recetas y de los proveedores, o creá un insumo nuevo con la otra unidad.`,
        409
      );
    }
  }

  const nextCost = new Prisma.Decimal(currentCost.toString());
  const previousCostForComparison = existing.currentCost ?? new Prisma.Decimal(0);
  const hasNoActualChange =
    previousCostForComparison.equals(nextCost) && existing.name === name && existing.unit === unit;

  // Costo manual que no coincide con la presentación predeterminada: sin acción elegida, 409 y no se guarda nada
  // (#427, ADR-011). Con el mismo costo, o si coincide con el de la presentación, se guarda como siempre.
  const defaultPresentation = defaultPresentations?.[0];
  const defaultUnitCost = defaultPresentation
    ? safeUnitCost(defaultPresentation.packagePrice, defaultPresentation.packageSize)
    : null;
  const costChanges = !previousCostForComparison.equals(nextCost);
  const contradictsDefault = Boolean(defaultPresentation && defaultUnitCost && costChanges && !defaultUnitCost.equals(nextCost));
  if (contradictsDefault && defaultPresentation && defaultUnitCost && !defaultPresentationAction) {
    return res.status(409).json({
      error:
        'El insumo tiene una presentación predeterminada con otro costo. Elegí si actualizás el precio de esa presentación o si dejás de usarla como predeterminada.',
      code: 'DEFAULT_PRESENTATION_MISMATCH',
      defaultPresentation: {
        id: defaultPresentation.id,
        supplierId: defaultPresentation.supplier.id,
        supplierName: defaultPresentation.supplier.name,
        packageSize: defaultPresentation.packageSize.toString(),
        packageUnit: defaultPresentation.packageUnit,
        packagePrice: defaultPresentation.packagePrice.toFixed(2),
        unitCost: defaultUnitCost.toFixed(2),
      },
    });
  }

  // update-presentation: el bulto pasa a costo × tamaño, redondeado al centavo, y el insumo guarda el costo que da ese
  // bulto. Con un tamaño con decimales (0,5 kg) puede diferir en centavos del tipeado, pero así el insumo y su
  // presentación predeterminada coinciden siempre (ADR-005, ADR-011). Un bulto fuera de rango no se guarda.
  let presentationUpdate: { packagePrice: Prisma.Decimal; unitCost: Prisma.Decimal } | null = null;
  if (contradictsDefault && defaultPresentation && defaultPresentationAction === 'update-presentation') {
    const packagePrice = nextCost.mul(defaultPresentation.packageSize).toDecimalPlaces(2, Prisma.Decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP);
    if (packagePrice.greaterThan(MAX_MONEY_VALUE)) {
      throw new AppError(
        'El precio del bulto no puede superar $99.999.999,99. Revisá el costo o dejá de usar esta presentación como predeterminada.',
        422
      );
    }
    const unitCost = safeUnitCost(packagePrice, defaultPresentation.packageSize);
    if (!unitCost) {
      throw new AppError(
        'Con ese costo, el precio del bulto no es válido para esta presentación. Revisá el costo o dejá de usar esta presentación como predeterminada.',
        422
      );
    }
    presentationUpdate = { packagePrice, unitCost };
  }
  const costToSave = presentationUpdate?.unitCost ?? nextCost;

  if (name.toLowerCase() !== existing.name.toLowerCase()) {
    const duplicate = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
      where: { accountId, name: { equals: name, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    });
    if (duplicate) {
      throw new AppError('Ya existe un insumo con ese nombre.', 409);
    }
  }

  if (hasNoActualChange) {
    return res.status(200).json({
      ingredient: existingIngredient,
      affectedProductsCount: 0,
      affectedProducts: [],
      criticalProducts: [],
    });
  }

  const previousCost = existing.currentCost ?? null;

  const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // La decisión sobre la presentación predeterminada va en la misma transacción que el costo (#427).
    if (presentationUpdate && defaultPresentation) {
      await tx.supplierIngredient.update({
        where: { id: defaultPresentation.id },
        data: { packagePrice: presentationUpdate.packagePrice },
      });
    } else if (contradictsDefault && defaultPresentation && defaultPresentationAction === 'clear-default') {
      await tx.supplierIngredient.update({ where: { id: defaultPresentation.id }, data: { isDefault: false } });
    }

    const ingredient = await tx.ingredient.update({
      where: { id },
      omit: { searchName: true },
      data: { name, searchName: normalizeSearchText(name), unit, currentCost: costToSave },
    });

    const { affectedProductsCount, affectedProducts, criticalProducts } = await applyIngredientCostChange(tx, id, previousCost, costToSave);

    return { ingredient, affectedProductsCount, affectedProducts, criticalProducts };
  });

  if (result.criticalProducts.length > 0) {
    void dispatchMarginAlertEvent({
      accountId,
      ingredientId: id,
      ingredientName: name,
      affectedProductsCount: result.affectedProductsCount,
      criticalProducts: result.criticalProducts.map((product) => ({
        productId: product.productId,
        productName: product.productName,
        previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
        newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
        currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
        minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      })),
    });
  }

  return res.status(200).json({
    ingredient: result.ingredient,
    affectedProductsCount: result.affectedProductsCount,
    affectedProducts: result.affectedProducts.map((product) => ({
      productId: product.productId,
      productName: product.productName,
      previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
      newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
      currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
    })),
    criticalProducts: result.criticalProducts.map((product) => ({
      productId: product.productId,
      productName: product.productName,
      previousCost: product.previousCost.toFixed(2),
      newCost: product.newCost.toFixed(2),
      currentMarginPercent: product.currentMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
      minMarginPercent: product.minMarginPercent.toFixed(2),
    })),
  });
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* DELETE /api/ingredients/:id                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
router.delete('/:id', requireRole(['ADMIN']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const accountId = req.user!.accountId;
  const id = getIdParam(req.params.id);
  if (!id) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const existing = await prisma.ingredient.findFirst({
    where: { id, accountId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    throw new AppError('Insumo no encontrado.', 404);
  }

  const usages = await prisma.productIngredient.findMany({
    where: { ingredientId: id },
    select: {
      product: {
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (usages.length > 0) {
    return res.status(409).json({
      error: 'No se puede eliminar el insumo porque forma parte de una o más recetas activas.',
      productsAffected: usages.map((u) => u.product),
    });
  }

  await prisma.ingredient.delete({ where: { id } });

  return res.status(200).json({ message: 'Insumo eliminado correctamente.' });
});

export default router;
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/app/productos/page.test.tsx">
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import { createMemoryRouter, MemoryRouter, RouterProvider } from 'react-router-dom'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { productService, type Product } from '@/services/productService'
import ProductsPage from './page'

/** La búsqueda espera 300 ms antes de ir a la API: margen para entornos cargados. */
const BUSQUEDA = { timeout: 3000 }

const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token')
const currentUser: { role: 'ADMIN' | 'COLLABORATOR' } = { role: 'ADMIN' }

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/useCurrentUser', () => ({
  useCurrentUser: () => ({ user: currentUser }),
}))

vi.mock('@/components/navbar', () => ({ Navbar: () => null }))
vi.mock('@/components/bottom-nav', () => ({ BottomNav: () => null }))
vi.mock('@/components/desktop-footer', () => ({ DesktopFooter: () => null }))

vi.mock('@/services/productService', () => ({
  productService: { list: vi.fn() },
}))

const TOTAL = 339
const producto = (i: number): Product => ({
  id: `prod-${i}`,
  name: `Medialuna de manteca ${i}`,
  salePrice: 950,
  cost: 410,
  marginPercent: 56.84,
  minMarginPercent: 30,
  ingredients: [],
})
const panDeSesamo: Product = { ...producto(250), id: 'prod-sesamo', name: 'Pan de hamburguesa con sésamo' }

const renderPage = () =>
  render(
    <MemoryRouter>
      <ProductsPage />
    </MemoryRouter>
  )

describe('ProductsPage - paginación y búsqueda en la API (#350)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'ADMIN'
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockImplementation(async (_getToken, params) => {
      if (params.search) {
        return { items: [panDeSesamo], meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: params.limit, totalPages: 1 } }
      }
      const start = (params.page - 1) * params.limit
      const items = Array.from({ length: Math.min(params.limit, TOTAL - start) }, (_, i) => producto(start + i))
      return { items, meta: { total: TOTAL, page: params.page, limit: params.limit, totalPages: Math.ceil(TOTAL / params.limit) } }
    })
  })

  it('muestra el total real del catálogo y navega con el paginador', async () => {
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByText('Mostrando 1–20 de 339 productos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Página siguiente' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Mostrando 21–40 de 339 productos')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(productService.list).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(getToken, { page: 2, limit: 20, search: '' })
  })

  it('en mobile, "Cargar más" suma la página siguiente', async () => {
    renderPage()
    expect(await screen.findByText('Mostrando 20 de 339 productos')).toBeInTheDocument()

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cargar más' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Mostrando 40 de 339 productos')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('busca contra la API y encuentra un producto fuera de la primera página', async () => {
    renderPage()
    await screen.findByText('Mostrando 1–20 de 339 productos')

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Buscar productos por nombre'), { target: { value: 'sesamo' } })

    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Pan de hamburguesa con sésamo', undefined, BUSQUEDA)).length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(productService.list).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(getToken, { page: 1, limit: 20, search: 'sesamo' })
  })

  it('una búsqueda sin resultados muestra el término buscado', async () => {
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockImplementation(async (_getToken, params) =>
      params.search
        ? { items: [], meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 0 } }
        : { items: [producto(1)], meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 1 } }
    )
    renderPage()
    await screen.findAllByText('Medialuna de manteca 1')

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Buscar productos por nombre'), { target: { value: 'chipa' } })

    expect(await screen.findByText('No hay productos que coincidan con la búsqueda "chipa".', undefined, BUSQUEDA)).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('sin productos muestra el estado vacío y no el paginador', async () => {
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockResolvedValue({ items: [], meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 0 } })
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByText('Aún no tenés productos cargados')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('navigation', { name: 'Paginación de productos' })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('el colaborador sin productos a la venta ve "Todavía no hay productos a la venta" (#428)', async () => {
    currentUser.role = 'COLLABORATOR'
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockResolvedValue({ items: [], meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 0 } })
    renderPage()

    expect(await screen.findByText('Todavía no hay productos a la venta')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getByText('Cuando el dueño cargue productos con receta y precio, vas a verlos acá.')).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Aún no tenés productos cargados')).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Crear mi primer producto' })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('el colaborador ve el catálogo paginado sin columnas financieras', async () => {
    currentUser.role = 'COLLABORATOR'
    renderPage()

    await screen.findByText('Mostrando 1–20 de 339 productos')
    expect(screen.queryByText('Costo (Receta)')).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Margen')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('muestra el error de la API si la carga falla', async () => {
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockRejectedValueOnce(new ApiError('No autorizado.', 401))
    renderPage()

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('No autorizado.')).toBeInTheDocument())
  })
})

describe('ProductsPage - aviso al colaborador redirigido (#364)', () => {
  const renderRedirigido = (state: unknown) => {
    const router = createMemoryRouter([{ path: '/productos', element: <ProductsPage /> }], {
      initialEntries: [{ pathname: '/productos', state }],
    })
    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />)
    return router
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'COLLABORATOR'
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [producto(1)],
      meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 1 },
    })
  })

  it('Escenario Gherkin "Colaborador redirigido": al volver desde /insumos ve que esa pantalla es del administrador', async () => {
    renderRedirigido({ adminOnlyFrom: '/insumos' })

    const aviso = await screen.findByRole('status')
    expect(aviso).toHaveTextContent('Esa pantalla es solo para el administrador')
    expect(aviso).toHaveTextContent('Te trajimos al catálogo de productos.')
  })

  it('el aviso se consume: el estado del historial se limpia para que recargar no lo repita', async () => {
    const router = renderRedirigido({ adminOnlyFrom: '/proveedores/cuarentena' })

    await screen.findByText('Esa pantalla es solo para el administrador')
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.state).toBeNull())
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe('/productos')
  })

  it('el aviso se puede cerrar con la X', async () => {
    renderRedirigido({ adminOnlyFrom: '/productos/nuevo' })

    await screen.findByText('Esa pantalla es solo para el administrador')
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cerrar notificación' }))

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.queryByText('Esa pantalla es solo para el administrador')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    )
  })

  it('entrar a /productos de forma normal no muestra ningún aviso', async () => {
    renderRedirigido(null)

    expect((await screen.findAllByText('Medialuna de manteca 1')).length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(screen.queryByText('Esa pantalla es solo para el administrador')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})

describe('ProductsPage - Escenario "Aviso al crear" (#432)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'ADMIN'
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [producto(1)],
      meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 1 },
    })
  })

  it('muestra en la lista el aviso que llega de crear o eliminar un producto, una sola vez', async () => {
    const router = createMemoryRouter([{ path: '/productos', element: <ProductsPage /> }], {
      initialEntries: [
        { pathname: '/productos', state: { productNotice: { title: 'Producto creado exitosamente con receta vinculada.', type: 'success' } } },
      ],
    })
    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />)

    expect(await screen.findByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Producto creado exitosamente con receta vinculada.')
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.state).toBeNull())
  })
})


describe('ProductsPage - nombre accesible de las filas en escritorio (WCAG 2.5.3, axe, RV488-I1)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    currentUser.role = 'ADMIN'
    vi.mocked(productService.list).mockResolvedValue({
      items: [producto(1)],
      meta: { total: 1, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 1 },
    })
  })

  it('la fila no usa aria-label: el nombre empieza por "Ver detalle del producto" y sigue con el texto que se ve', async () => {
    renderPage()

    const fila = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Ver detalle del producto Medialuna de manteca 1/ })
    // Con aria-label, el nombre no incluía el costo, el precio ni el margen que se ven en la fila.
    expect(fila).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-label')
    expect(fila).toHaveAccessibleName(/^Ver detalle del producto Medialuna de manteca 1 .*950/)
  })
})

<file path="frontend/src/app/proveedores/[id]/page.tsx">
'use client'

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import {
  CircleCheck,
  CirclePause,
  Mail,
  MapPin,
  LoaderCircle,
  PackageOpen,
  Phone,
  Search,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react'

import { usePaginatedList } from '@/hooks/usePaginatedList'
import { useTokenGetter } from '@/hooks/useTokenGetter'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/useToast'
import { BottomNav } from '@/components/bottom-nav'
import { DesktopFooter } from '@/components/desktop-footer'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/empty-state'
import { ErrorState } from '@/components/error-state'
import { Navbar } from '@/components/navbar'
import { Pagination } from '@/components/pagination'
import { ToastAlert } from '@/components/ToastAlert'
import { ApiError } from '@/services/api'
import { fetchAllPages, type PageParams } from '@/services/pagination'
import {
  supplierService,
  type SupplierDetail,
  type SupplierIngredient,
  type SupplierPresentation,
} from '@/services/supplierService'

import { PresentationDeleteDialog } from './components/PresentationDeleteDialog'
import { PresentationEditDialog } from './components/PresentationEditDialog'
import { SupplierPresentationsList } from './components/SupplierPresentationsList'
import { formatMoney } from '@/lib/format'
import { MakeDefaultDialog } from '@/components/make-default-dialog'

interface ContactChip {
  key: 'phone' | 'email' | 'address'
  label: string
  value: string
  Icon: LucideIcon
}

/** Datos de contacto cargados, en orden fijo y con un rótulo para el lector de pantalla. */
function supplierContactChips(supplier: SupplierDetail): ContactChip[] {
  const chips: Array<ContactChip | null> = [
    supplier.contactPhone ? { key: 'phone', label: 'Teléfono', value: supplier.contactPhone, Icon: Phone } : null,
    supplier.email ? { key: 'email', label: 'Correo', value: supplier.email, Icon: Mail } : null,
    supplier.address ? { key: 'address', label: 'Dirección', value: supplier.address, Icon: MapPin } : null,
  ]
  return chips.filter((chip): chip is ContactChip => chip !== null)
}

function SupplierDetailSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div role="status" className="space-y-6">
      <span className="sr-only">Cargando detalle del proveedor...</span>
      <div className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800" />
      <div className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800" />
    </div>
  )
}

export default function SupplierDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const getToken = useTokenGetter()

  const [supplier, setSupplier] = useState<SupplierDetail | null>(null)
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ defaultCount: 0, quarantinedCount: 0 })
  const [statsKey, setStatsKey] = useState(0)

  const [editingPresentation, setEditingPresentation] = useState<SupplierPresentation | null>(null)
  const [deletingPresentation, setDeletingPresentation] = useState<SupplierPresentation | null>(null)

  const { toast, notify, dismiss: dismissToast } = useToast()

  // Presentaciones paginadas y filtradas en la API; la ficha del proveedor llega en la misma respuesta.
  const fetchPresentations = useCallback(
    async (params: PageParams) => {
      const result = await supplierService.getPage(getToken, id ?? '', params)
      setSupplier(result.supplier)
      return { items: result.supplier.ingredients ?? [], meta: result.meta }
    },
    [getToken, id]
  )
  const {
    items: presentations,
    meta,
    catalogTotal,
    error: loadError,
    isLoading,
    isLoadingMore,
    page,
    limit,
    search,
    appliedSearch,
    hasMore,
    setSearch,
    goToPage,
    setLimit,
    loadMore,
    reload: handleRetry,
    setItems: setPresentations,
  } = usePaginatedList(fetchPresentations, { errorMessage: 'No se pudieron cargar los datos del proveedor.' })

  // Los contadores de la ficha cubren todas las presentaciones, no solo la página visible.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return
    let active = true
    fetchAllPages(async (params) => {
      const result = await supplierService.getPage(getToken, id, params)
      return { items: result.supplier.ingredients ?? [], meta: result.meta }
    })
      .then((all) => {
        if (active) {
          setStats({
            defaultCount: all.filter((p) => p.isDefault).length,
            quarantinedCount: all.filter((p) => p.isQuarantined).length,
          })
        }
      })
      .catch(() => undefined)
    return () => {
      active = false
    }
  }, [getToken, id, statsKey])

  const refreshStats = () => setStatsKey((prev) => prev + 1)

  const handleSavedPresentation = (updated: SupplierIngredient) => {
    setPresentations((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        if (item.ingredient.id === updated.ingredientId) {
          return {
            ...item,
            packageSize: updated.packageSize,
            packagePrice: updated.packagePrice,
            isDefault: updated.isDefault,
            supplierCode: updated.supplierCode ?? null,
            rawDescription: updated.rawDescription ?? null,
          }
        }
        return item
      })
    )
    refreshStats()
    notify('Presentación actualizada correctamente')
  }

  const handleDeletedPresentation = (deleted: SupplierPresentation) => {
    handleRetry()
    refreshStats()
    notify(`Presentación de "${deleted.ingredient.name}" eliminada`)
  }

  // Presentación que espera confirmación antes de pasar a ser la predeterminada (#434).
  const [defaultCandidate, setDefaultCandidate] = useState<SupplierPresentation | null>(null)
  const [isSettingDefault, setIsSettingDefault] = useState(false)

  const handleMakeDefault = async (presentation: SupplierPresentation) => {
    if (!supplier) return
    setIsSettingDefault(true)
    try {
      const result = await supplierService.addPackaging(getToken, supplier.id, {
        ingredientId: presentation.ingredient.id,
        packageSize: Number(presentation.packageSize),
        packageUnit: presentation.packageUnit as 'kg' | 'l' | 'u',
        packagePrice: Number(presentation.packagePrice),
        isDefault: true,
        supplierCode: presentation.supplierCode ?? null,
        rawDescription: presentation.rawDescription ?? null,
      })

      const finalCost =
        typeof result.unitCost === 'number' ? result.unitCost : Number(result.unitCost)

      setPresentations((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (item.id === presentation.id ? { ...item, isDefault: true } : item))
      )
      refreshStats()

      notify(
        `Presentación de "${presentation.ingredient.name}" establecida como predeterminada`,
        'success',
        `Costo activo actualizado a ${formatMoney(finalCost)}`
      )
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      notify(
        error instanceof ApiError
          ? error.message
          : 'No se pudo conmutar la presentación predeterminada.',
        'error'
      )
    } finally {
      setIsSettingDefault(false)
      setDefaultCandidate(null)
    }
  }

  const contactChips = supplier ? supplierContactChips(supplier) : []

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-950 dark:text-gray-100">
      {toast && (
        <ToastAlert
          key={toast.id}
          title={toast.title}
          description={toast.description}
          type={toast.type}
          onClose={dismissToast}
        />
      )}

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-md flex-1 flex-col px-4 pt-5 md:max-w-5xl md:px-8 lg:max-w-6xl lg:px-12">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 pb-28 md:pb-12">
          <Navbar title="Detalle de proveedor" backHref="/proveedores" />

          {isLoading && !supplier && <SupplierDetailSkeleton />}

          {!isLoading && loadError && (
            <ErrorState
              title="Error al cargar el proveedor"
              description={loadError}
              onRetry={handleRetry}
            />
          )}

          {!loadError && supplier && (
            <>
              {/* Tarjeta de Información del Proveedor */}
              <section className="rounded-3xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm md:p-6 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
                <div data-testid="supplier-identity" className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                      <h1 className="min-w-0 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-950 md:text-3xl dark:text-white">
                        {supplier.name}
                      </h1>
                      {supplier.isActive ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-emerald-600/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
                          <CircleCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          Activo
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 ring-1 ring-gray-500/20 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300">
                          <CirclePause className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          Inactivo
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      Gestioná sus presentaciones comerciales, códigos SKU y factores de bulto.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Datos de contacto debajo del nombre, en una fila que baja de renglón (#362). */}
                  {contactChips.length > 0 && (
                    <ul aria-label="Datos de contacto" className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
                      {contactChips.map(({ key, label, value, Icon }) => (
                        <li
                          key={key}
                          className="inline-flex min-w-0 max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 wrap-anywhere rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300"
                        >
                          <Icon className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" aria-hidden="true" />
                          <span className="sr-only">{label}: </span>
                          {value}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 border-t border-gray-100 pt-5 dark:border-gray-800">
                  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/70 p-3 text-center dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">Presentaciones</p>
                    <p className="text-xl font-black text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-100">{catalogTotal ?? meta?.total ?? 0}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50/70 p-3 text-center dark:bg-emerald-950/40">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">Predeterminadas</p>
                    <p className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-100">{stats.defaultCount}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-center dark:bg-amber-950/40">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">En cuarentena</p>
                    <p className="text-xl font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100">{stats.quarantinedCount}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* Lista de Presentaciones o Estado Vacío */}
              <section aria-labelledby="presentations-heading">
                <div className="mb-3 flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
                  <h2 id="presentations-heading" className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight">
                    Presentaciones del proveedor ({meta?.total ?? 0})
                  </h2>
                  {(catalogTotal ?? 0) > 0 && (
                    <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
                      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3.5">
                        <Search className="size-4 text-gray-400" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </span>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={search}
                        onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Buscar por insumo o código..."
                        aria-label="Buscar presentaciones por insumo o código"
                        className="h-11 w-full rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-indigo-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-600/20 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white dark:placeholder-gray-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {isLoading ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-10 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500 shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
                    <LoaderCircle className="mr-2 size-5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> Cargando presentaciones...
                  </div>
                ) : presentations.length === 0 && appliedSearch ? (
                  <EmptyState
                    icon={<Search className="size-6" />}
                    title="Presentación no encontrada"
                    description={`No hay presentaciones que coincidan con "${appliedSearch}".`}
                  />
                ) : presentations.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState
                    icon={<PackageOpen className="size-6" />}
                    title="Sin presentaciones cargadas"
                    description="Este proveedor todavía no tiene insumos ni presentaciones vinculadas. Para asociarlo, abrí la ficha del insumo en Insumos."
                    actionLabel="Ir a Insumos"
                    onAction={() => navigate('/insumos')}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <SupplierPresentationsList
                      presentations={presentations}
                      onEdit={(p) => setEditingPresentation(p)}
                      onDelete={(p) => setDeletingPresentation(p)}
                      onMakeDefault={setDefaultCandidate}
                    />
                    {meta && (
                      <Pagination
                        page={page}
                        totalPages={meta.totalPages}
                        total={meta.total}
                        limit={limit}
                        shown={presentations.length}
                        itemLabel="presentaciones"
                        hasMore={hasMore}
                        isLoadingMore={isLoadingMore}
                        onPageChange={goToPage}
                        onLimitChange={setLimit}
                        onLoadMore={loadMore}
                      />
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </section>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <DesktopFooter />
      </div>
      <BottomNav />

      {editingPresentation && supplier && (
        <PresentationEditDialog
          open={editingPresentation !== null}
          supplierId={supplier.id}
          presentation={editingPresentation}
          onClose={() => setEditingPresentation(null)}
          onSaved={handleSavedPresentation}
        />
      )}

      {deletingPresentation && supplier && (
        <PresentationDeleteDialog
          open={deletingPresentation !== null}
          supplierId={supplier.id}
          presentation={deletingPresentation}
          onClose={() => setDeletingPresentation(null)}
          onDeleted={handleDeletedPresentation}
        />
      )}
      <MakeDefaultDialog
        open={defaultCandidate !== null}
        ingredientName={defaultCandidate?.ingredient.name ?? ''}
        supplierName={supplier?.name ?? ''}
        unitCost={defaultCandidate ? (Number(defaultCandidate.packagePrice) || 0) / (Number(defaultCandidate.packageSize) || 1) : 0}
        unit={defaultCandidate?.packageUnit ?? ''}
        isSaving={isSettingDefault}
        onConfirm={() => {
          if (defaultCandidate) void handleMakeDefault(defaultCandidate)
        }}
        onCancel={() => setDefaultCandidate(null)}
      />
    </main>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/__tests__/dialogos-accesibles.test.tsx">
import type { ReactElement } from 'react'
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import { createMemoryRouter, MemoryRouter, RouterProvider } from 'react-router-dom'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'

import type { productSchema } from '@/schemas/productSchema'
import type { ingredientSchema } from '@/schemas/ingredientSchema'
import { QuickCreateIngredientModal } from '@/components/quick-create-ingredient-modal'

vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('token-de-prueba') }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/ingredientService', async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import('@/services/ingredientService')>()
  return {
    ...original,
    ingredientService: { ...original.ingredientService, getHistory: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]) },
  }
})

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import('@/services/supplierService')>()
  return {
    ...original,
    supplierService: {
      ...original.supplierService,
      getById: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'sup-molino', ingredients: [] }),
    },
  }
})

const molino: SupplierSummary = {
  id: 'sup-molino',
  accountId: 'acc-panaderia',
  name: 'Molino Olavarriense',
  contactPhone: '+54 9 2284 41-5566',
  email: null,
  address: null,
  isActive: true,
  ingredientCount: 0,
  quarantineCount: 0,
}

const harina: Ingredient = { id: 'ing-harina', name: 'Harina 000', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 850 }
const levadura: Ingredient = { id: 'ing-levadura', name: 'Levadura fresca', unit: 'kg', currentCost: 4200 }

type ProductInput = z.input<typeof productSchema>
type IngredientInput = z.input<typeof ingredientSchema>

function SimulatorSheetHarness() {
  const { register, setValue, formState } = useForm<ProductInput>()
  return (
    <ProductMobileSimulatorSheet
      isOpen
      onClose={vi.fn()}
      gain={420}
      cost={980}
      margin={30}
      targetMargin={35}
      hasRecipe
      watchedSalePrice={1400}
      isSaving={false}
      activeStrategy="custom"
      flashingKey={null}
      register={register}
      setValue={setValue}
      errors={formState.errors}
      onAdjustPriceFactor={vi.fn()}
      onApplySuggestedMargin={vi.fn()}
      onSave={vi.fn()}
      setActiveStrategy={vi.fn()}
    />
  )
}

function IngredientSheetHarness({ selected, showDeleteConfirm = false }: { selected: Ingredient | null; showDeleteConfirm?: boolean }) {
  const { register, setValue, formState } = useForm<IngredientInput>()
  return (
    <MemoryRouter>
      <IngredientUpsertSheet
        selected={selected}
        newOpen={!selected}
        showDeleteConfirm={showDeleteConfirm}
        isCollaborator={false}
        onSubmit={vi.fn()}
        onRequestClose={vi.fn()}
        onRequestDelete={vi.fn()}
        onDeleteConfirm={vi.fn()}
        onCancelDelete={vi.fn()}
        onOpenHistory={vi.fn()}
        onOpenPackaging={vi.fn()}
        onEditConnection={vi.fn()}
        onMakeDefault={vi.fn()}
        register={register}
        setValue={setValue}
        errors={formState.errors}
        selectedUnit="kg"
        money={(value) => `$${value}`}
        onNumericKeyDown={vi.fn()}
        onDecimalChange={vi.fn()}
      />
    </MemoryRouter>
  )
}

// SupplierFormDialog usa useBlocker (cambios sin guardar), que exige un router de datos.
const enRouterDeDatos = (ui: ReactElement) => (
  <RouterProvider router={createMemoryRouter([{ path: '/', element: ui }])} />
)

const casos: Array<{ nombre: string; ui: ReactElement; titulo: string | RegExp }> = [
  {
    nombre: 'Cerrar sesión',
    ui: <LogoutDialog open onConfirm={vi.fn()} onCancel={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: '¿Cerrar sesión?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Cambios sin guardar',
    ui: <UnsavedChangesDialog open onConfirm={vi.fn()} onCancel={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: '¿Descartar cambios?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Soporte y documentación',
    ui: <SupportDocsModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: 'Soporte y Documentación',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Historial de precios',
    ui: <PriceHistoryModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} ingredientId={harina.id} ingredientName={harina.name} />,
    titulo: /Harina 000/,
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Eliminar producto',
    ui: <ProductDeleteDialog isOpen isDeleting={false} productName="Medialunas de manteca" onClose={vi.fn()} onConfirm={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: '¿Eliminar producto?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Quitar insumo de la receta',
    ui: <ProductRemoveIngredientDialog ingredientName="Levadura fresca" onClose={vi.fn()} onConfirm={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: '¿Quitar insumo de la receta?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Sumar insumo a la receta',
    ui: (
      <ProductAddIngredientModal
        isOpen
        onClose={vi.fn()}
        availablePantry={[harina, levadura]}
        isLoadingSupplies={false}
        onAdd={vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)}
      />
    ),
    titulo: 'Sumar Insumo a la Receta',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Simulador de precio (mobile)',
    ui: <SimulatorSheetHarness />,
    titulo: /Simulador de Precio/,
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Nuevo insumo',
    ui: <IngredientSheetHarness selected={null} />,
    titulo: 'Nuevo insumo',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Editar insumo',
    ui: <IngredientSheetHarness selected={harina} />,
    titulo: 'Editar insumo',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Eliminar insumo',
    ui: <IngredientSheetHarness selected={harina} showDeleteConfirm />,
    titulo: '¿Eliminar insumo?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Nuevo proveedor',
    ui: enRouterDeDatos(<SupplierFormDialog open supplier={null} onClose={vi.fn()} onSaved={vi.fn()} />),
    titulo: 'Nuevo proveedor',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Editar proveedor',
    ui: enRouterDeDatos(<SupplierFormDialog open supplier={molino} onClose={vi.fn()} onSaved={vi.fn()} />),
    titulo: 'Editar proveedor',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Dar de baja un proveedor',
    ui: (
      <SupplierDeleteDialog open supplier={molino} onClose={vi.fn()} onDeleted={vi.fn()} onDeactivated={vi.fn()} />
    ),
    titulo: '¿Dar de baja a Molino Olavarriense?',
  },
  {
    nombre: 'Alta rápida de insumo desde la receta',
    ui: <QuickCreateIngredientModal isOpen onClose={vi.fn()} onCreated={vi.fn()} />,
    titulo: 'Nuevo insumo',
  },
]

describe('Diálogos de MargenX: título, descripción y botones con nombre accesible', () => {
  it.each(casos)('$nombre', async ({ ui, titulo }) => {
    render(ui)
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog')

    expect(dialog).toHaveAccessibleName(titulo)
    expect(dialog).toHaveAccessibleDescription(/\S/)

    for (const button of within(dialog).getAllByRole('button')) {
      expect(button).toHaveAccessibleName(/\S/)
    }
  })
})
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/__tests__/supplier-packaging-modal.test.tsx">
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { SupplierPackagingModal } from '../supplier-packaging-modal'
import { supplierService, type SupplierIngredient } from '@/services/supplierService'
import type { Ingredient } from '@/services/ingredientService'

// Como en Clerk, getToken conserva su referencia entre renders: si cambiara, el modal
// volvería a pedir los proveedores y la prueba no reflejaría lo que pasa en la app.
const getToken = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('fake-token')
vi.mock('@clerk/clerk-react', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ getToken }),
}))

vi.mock('@/services/supplierService', () => ({
  supplierService: {
    getAll: vi.fn(),
    addPackaging: vi.fn(),
    create: vi.fn(),
  },
}))

type SupplierRow = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof supplierService.getAll>>[number]

function buildSupplier(id: string, name: string): SupplierRow {
  const supplier = { id, name, accountId: 'acc-1', isActive: true, ingredientCount: 0, quarantineCount: 0 }
  return supplier
}

describe('SupplierPackagingModal', () => {
  const mockSupplierConnection: SupplierIngredient = {
    id: 'conn-1',
    supplierId: 'sup-1',
